item.300th_spear.description: A long, gleaming spear with a notch in the shaft for every kill.
item.300th_spear.lore: The notches stop at 299. Someone wanted you to carve the next one.
item.300th_spear.name: 300th Spear
item.aezyn.description: Slender bracers of black metal with glowing violet lines running toward the wrist.
item.aezyn.lore: The glow answers whenever an arrow is drawn. Nobody agrees how the name is pronounced, and the bracers do not correct anyone.
item.aezyn.name: Aezyn
item.aezyn.unique: Magic Arrow damage scaling increases by 666%.
item.alexander_s_shield.description: A battered round shield, its face scarred by countless blows and a faded crest.
item.alexander_s_shield.lore: Found in a bunker stairwell, clutched by a soldier who held the line long after anyone could see it. The crest is a bird, or possibly a fist.
item.alexander_s_shield.name: Alexander's Shield
item.alexander_s_shield.unique: Taking a hit can trigger Parry on its own. Requires Parry to be equipped.
item.ancient_greatbow.description: A huge, creaking bow carved from a single pale trunk and wrapped in sinew.
item.ancient_greatbow.lore: It was old before the island had any visitors. Drawing it takes both arms and a moment of honest regret.
item.ancient_greatbow.name: Ancient Greatbow
item.ancient_scroll.description: A brittle, yellowed scroll covered in tight script that crackles when unrolled.
item.ancient_scroll.lore: It predates the resort, the bunkers, and probably the island's name. The first line is a single word: burn.
item.ancient_scroll.name: Ancient Scroll
item.anger.description: A long sword with a blade the color of old blood and a grip wrapped in wet leather.
item.anger.lore: It remembers every hand that held it, and none of them let go willingly.
item.anger.name: Anger
item.anger.unique: Raises your maximum Frenzy stacks by 15.
item.archangel.description: A white greatbow with feathered limbs and a gentle, honest glow.
item.archangel.lore: Built by a man who thought he could mend a squad's wounds with the right arrow. Aim at an ally and the bow cooperates.
item.archangel.name: Archangel
item.archangel.unique: Shooting another player empowers them for 30 seconds.
item.archer_s_gear.description: A lightweight leather harness with arrow loops, wrist guards and a hood that hides your face.
item.archer_s_gear.lore: Built for someone who intended to be gone before the first shout. It has been worn by three archers, and only one of them is still looking.
item.archer_s_gear.name: Archer's Gear
item.armored_boots.description: Heavy steel-toed boots with riveted plates over the shins and ankles.
item.armored_boots.lore: Built for kicking in doors and, apparently, ribs. They clank so loudly the cannibals hear you from three ridges away.
item.armored_boots.name: Armored Boots
item.armored_hood.description: A sturdy hood of chain and leather that covers the head and neck.
item.armored_hood.lore: Quiet, soft and surprisingly strong. A scout's idea of a crown.
item.armored_hood.name: Armored Hood
item.armsy_finger_necklace.description: A cord strung with yellowed finger bones, clicking softly against each other.
item.armsy_finger_necklace.lore: The bones are far too numerous for any one hand. Wearing them makes your own fingers itch, as if they were being counted.
item.armsy_finger_necklace.name: Knucklebone Necklace
item.armsy_skin_footwear.description: Tight boots stitched from pale, pebbled mutant hide that still seems faintly warm.
item.armsy_skin_footwear.lore: The seams were sewn by something with too many fingers and no sense of tailoring. The boots fit anyway, which is the worst part.
item.armsy_skin_footwear.name: Fleshhide Footwear
item.army_boots.description: Steel-toed combat boots, laced tight and built for a long march.
item.army_boots.lore: Regulation issue from a complex nobody admits to funding. They hit the ground like a verdict, and enemies tend to hear it coming a beat too late.
item.army_boots.name: Army Boots
item.ash_rosary.description: A string of grey beads pressed from compacted cremation ash.
item.ash_rosary.lore: Count the beads and you will always come up one short. The cult says that bead is yours.
item.ash_rosary.name: Ash Rosary
item.assassins_pauldrons.description: Dark, low-profile pauldrons fitted with tiny blades hidden along the edges.
item.assassins_pauldrons.lore: Silent in motion and in meaning. The wearer's reputation precedes them mostly by being absent.
item.assassins_pauldrons.name: Assassins Pauldrons
item.atomic_augmentation.description: Heavy boots with a faintly glowing core in each heel, ticking like a Geiger counter.
item.atomic_augmentation.lore: A bunker experiment that was supposed to make soldiers faster. It definitely made them something.
item.atomic_augmentation.name: Atomic Augmentation
item.atomic_augmentation.unique: Set piece. Melee weapon range +30% and melee attacks cost half the stamina.
item.axe_of_misfortune.description: A black-bladed axe whose edge has a faint, pitted look, like something chewed it.
item.axe_of_misfortune.lore: The cult buried this under a shrine, and every shrine around it fell apart. They call that a warning. The rest of the island calls it a fair price.
item.axe_of_misfortune.name: Axe of Misfortune
item.axe_of_swiftness.description: A lean axe with a wind-worn haft and a blade ground thin as paper.
item.axe_of_swiftness.lore: Cut from a tribal hunter's belt after a chase that ended before he saw the swing. It remembers the hurry.
item.axe_of_swiftness.name: Axe of Swiftness
item.band_of_hurting.description: A black iron ring with a jagged edge on the inside.
item.band_of_hurting.lore: It bites the wearer first. The tribes say this is how it learns the shape of your anger.
item.band_of_hurting.name: Band of Hurting
item.baron_wristguards.description: Ornate gold-trimmed wristguards engraved with the crest of a dead house.
item.baron_wristguards.lore: The resort's owner wore them at dinners. Nobody is left to claim the title.
item.baron_wristguards.name: Baron Wristguards
item.battle_scarred_shoulder_pads.descri: Heavy steel pads gouged by claws, teeth and one very angry hatchet.
item.battle_scarred_shoulder_pads.lore: Every dent is a fight survived. The previous owner is a different story.
item.battle_scarred_shoulder_pads.name: Battle scarred Shoulder Pads
item.bear_skin_armor.description: A shaggy bear pelt cut into a cuirass, claws still hanging from the shoulders.
item.bear_skin_armor.lore: The bear was bigger than the man who skinned it. The man is not mentioned in the stories, only the coat.
item.bear_skin_armor.name: Bear Skin Armor
item.black_hammer.description: A massive war hammer of blackened steel with a head the size of a loaf of bread.
item.black_hammer.lore: It has crushed shields, kneecaps and at least one wall. It is never clean, and it has never needed to be.
item.black_hammer.name: Black Hammer
item.black_hammer.unique: Hits slow the enemy they strike.
item.black_steel_leggins.description: Dark steel leg guards blackened by fire and old oil.
item.black_steel_leggins.lore: Forged in a cult furnace where the flames never went out. Neither did the smith.
item.black_steel_leggins.name: Black Steel Leggins
item.bloodthirster.description: A long sword of dark steel with a narrow channel running down the center of the blade.
item.bloodthirster.lore: The channel is there for a reason, and the reason is plain. It never stays clean for more than a moment.
item.bloodthirster.name: Bloodthirster
item.bloodthirster.unique: Bash heals you and restores energy equal to 2% of damage dealt.
item.blunt_blade_for_bashing_skulls.desc: A greatsword with the edge ground off and the flat studded with iron nails.
item.blunt_blade_for_bashing_skulls.lore: Made for people who never wanted to cut anything, only to be loud about it.
item.blunt_blade_for_bashing_skulls.name: Blunt Blade for Bashing Skulls
item.blunt_blade_for_bashing_skulls.uniq: Bash's damage-taken debuff on enemies increases by 200%.
item.boar_skin_armor.description: A crude cuirass of bristly boar hide, laced down the sides with sinew.
item.boar_skin_armor.lore: Tanned by someone who clearly took a tusk or two in the process. The bristles still stand up whenever something approaches from behind.
item.boar_skin_armor.name: Boar Skin Armor
item.bombastinc_choker.description: A heavy choker studded with small brass shells and a coiled fuse.
item.bombastinc_choker.lore: It looks like jewelry and acts like ordnance. The wearer is advised not to laugh too hard.
item.bombastinc_choker.name: Bombastinc Choker
item.bone_shield.description: A shield made from a flattened ribcage, lashed together with sinew and painted with warnings.
item.bone_shield.lore: A tribal craftsman's work, with a ruthless eye for what survives a hit. The warnings are for the enemy, and the fear is a nice bonus.
item.bone_shield.name: Bone Shield
item.bottled_cave_water.description: A glass bottle of icy water, faintly luminous.
item.bottled_cave_water.lore: It tastes of nothing, and of cold, and of somewhere very far underground.
item.bottled_cave_water.name: Bottled Cave Water
item.bottled_cave_water.unique: Consume to cleanse a debuff and restore a moderate amount of energy.
item.brawler_s_gloves.description: Battered boxing gloves wrapped in tape and spattered with older stains.
item.brawler_s_gloves.lore: Used on a canopy-covered arena where the tribes settle their disputes. There is no referee, and no one counts to ten.
item.brawler_s_gloves.name: Brawler's Gloves
item.broken_flip_flops.description: A pair of sun-bleached flip-flops, one strap snapped and tied back with a knot.
item.broken_flip_flops.lore: Left behind by someone who packed for a beach holiday. The island has had opinions about that ever since.
item.broken_flip_flops.name: Broken Flip-Flops
item.broken_leather_shoulder_armor.descr: A ripped leather shoulder pad with a missing strap and sweat-stained padding.
item.broken_leather_shoulder_armor.lore: It cushions one shoulder and insults the other. Better than a bare shoulder, which the island is always eager to bite.
item.broken_leather_shoulder_armor.name: Broken Leather Shoulder Armor
item.broken_loop.description: A bent metal ring that no longer closes, with a dull gleam in the dent.
item.broken_loop.lore: Probably a keyring once, or a curtain ring, or a cheap promise. You wear it anyway because rings tend to pay back.
item.broken_loop.name: Broken Loop
item.broken_protector.description: A cracked shield missing a chunk from its rim, with a bent handle.
item.broken_protector.lore: It has stopped something it should not have been able to stop. The crack is the thing's souvenir.
item.broken_protector.name: Broken Protector
item.broken_shield.description: A splintered plank of a shield with a cracked handle and half its rim missing.
item.broken_shield.lore: It stopped one blow and was rewarded with retirement. You are asking it to do a little more than that.
item.broken_shield.name: Broken shield
item.buckler.description: A small round shield of riveted steel with a spiked central boss.
item.buckler.lore: Light enough to forget you're holding it, until someone swings at your head.
item.buckler.name: Buckler
item.bunny_ears_hairband.description: A neat black hairband with two stiff, upright satin ears.
item.bunny_ears_hairband.lore: Pristine, as if the island never touched it. Somehow that is the most unsettling thing about it.
item.bunny_ears_hairband.name: Bunny Ears Hairband
item.canned_pasta_ration.description: A dented can of bunker-issue pasta of uncertain age.
item.canned_pasta_ration.lore: The label says 'Just Add Water.' The water in the can was already there.
item.canned_pasta_ration.name: Canned Pasta Ration
item.canned_pasta_ration.unique: Consume to restore a moderate amount of life and stamina.
item.cargo_shorts.description: Khaki shorts with six bulging pockets and a belt loop for every bad idea.
item.cargo_shorts.lore: Tourists swore by them. The pockets hold sticks, rocks, rope and surprising amounts of snacks, which is all the survival philosophy you need.
item.cargo_shorts.name: Cargo Shorts
item.cargo_shorts_mk2.description: Khaki cargo shorts with far too many pockets and a new reinforced waistband.
item.cargo_shorts_mk2.lore: The Mark 2 fixes the first one's one flaw: it now holds more things than any sane person owns. Knees are still on their own.
item.cargo_shorts_mk2.name: Cargo Shorts MK2
item.celestial_moonstone.description: A perfect pale gem that casts a cold, steady moonlight of its own.
item.celestial_moonstone.lore: No known cave produced it. It was found in a field in the snow, at the exact center of a circle of frost.
item.celestial_moonstone.name: Celestial Moonstone
item.celestial_moonstone.unique: Socket it into an empty slot on a piece of gear to add stats to that item.
item.celestial_sapphire.description: A flawless blue gem that seems to hold a whole night sky.
item.celestial_sapphire.lore: Look long enough and the stars inside begin to move. Look longer, and some of them look back.
item.celestial_sapphire.name: Celestial Sapphire
item.celestial_sapphire.unique: Socket it into an empty slot on a piece of gear to add stats to that item.
item.censer_gloves.description: Heavy leather gloves with chains and a tiny smoking brazier dangling from each wrist.
item.censer_gloves.lore: The smoke smells like pine and burnt hair. Wearers report calmer thoughts and a worrying lack of appetite.
item.censer_gloves.name: Censer Gloves
item.chaos_water.description: A cloudy bottle of water that never settles, with tiny things swimming in it.
item.chaos_water.lore: Poured from a spring that no map includes. Splash it on gear and see what the island decides.
item.chaos_water.name: Chaos Water
item.chaos_water.unique: Rerolls every stat on an item of Legendary rarity or lower.
item.chastity_belt.description: A heavy iron belt with a rusted lock and no key in sight.
item.chastity_belt.lore: Found in a resort suite, which raises more questions than it answers. It is oddly comfortable for a night in the dirt.
item.chastity_belt.name: Chastity belt
item.chastity_belt.unique: You take 100% less damage while sleeping.
item.chromium_ore.description: A shiny, mirror-bright chunk of ore with a faint rainbow sheen.
item.chromium_ore.lore: It does not rust, which on this island counts as a miracle. Brush it clean and it shows your face back at you.
item.chromium_ore.name: Chromium Ore
item.chromium_ore.unique: Socket it into an empty slot on a piece of gear to add stats to that item.
item.clear_moonstone.description: A smooth, pale stone with a ring of blue light around its edge.
item.clear_moonstone.lore: The ring gets brighter in the dark, and brighter still when something is close by.
item.clear_moonstone.name: Clear Moonstone
item.clear_moonstone.unique: Socket it into an empty slot on a piece of gear to add stats to that item.
item.clear_sapphire.description: A cleaner blue stone with a faint glow when held to the light.
item.clear_sapphire.lore: Someone spent a long night polishing it with a belt. It rewarded them with a steady glow.
item.clear_sapphire.name: Clear Sapphire
item.clear_sapphire.unique: Socket it into an empty slot on a piece of gear to add stats to that item.
item.cloth_band.description: A simple band of cloth wound around the wrist and forearm.
item.cloth_band.lore: It does little, but it is all you have. Many great fights began with less.
item.cloth_band.name: Cloth Band
item.cloth_pants.description: Plain cloth pants, patched at the knee with a different color of cloth.
item.cloth_pants.lore: Not armor in any real sense, but the island's dignity only goes as far as you let it, and these are a start.
item.cloth_pants.name: Cloth Pants
item.clubhouse_visor.description: A white sun visor with a monogram, a bullet graze, and a faint scent of sunscreen.
item.clubhouse_visor.lore: Members only. The membership card is still in the band, along with a handwritten note: 'Do not let them see you sweat.'
item.clubhouse_visor.name: Clubhouse Visor
item.cowman_toe_necklace.description: A heavy cord strung with thick, yellowed toes, each as big as a thumb.
item.cowman_toe_necklace.lore: The hulk who owned them did not enjoy being relieved of the burden. Wearing them is an act of defiance and a surprisingly practical hand warmer.
item.cowman_toe_necklace.name: Hulk Toe Necklace
item.crimson_solution.description: A vial of luminous red liquid that seems to boil without heat.
item.crimson_solution.lore: Brewed from the blood of the deep caves, or so the cult says. Legends get made this way. So do funerals.
item.crimson_solution.name: Crimson Solution
item.crimson_solution.unique: Upgrades an item of any rarity into an item of the same type with Legendary rarity.
item.cripplers.description: Black leather gloves studded with sharp, mismatched fish hooks along the knuckles.
item.cripplers.lore: The seams are stained from the inside. The previous owner liked to watch targets stumble, and it shows in the wear.
item.cripplers.name: Cripplers
item.cripplers.unique: Magic arrow debuffs last 15 seconds longer.
item.crocodile_skin_armor.description: A vest of overlapping crocodile scales, heavy, cold and unreasonably smug.
item.crocodile_skin_armor.lore: Taken from a swamp predator that thought you were lunch. The scales remember being on the winning side and try to repeat the experience.
item.crocodile_skin_armor.name: Crocodile Skin Armor
item.crossfire.description: A scorched leather quiver stitched with crossed arrows and charred along the rim.
item.crossfire.lore: The cult used to hang these on poles as warnings. Run past one and you can swear the arrows rearranged themselves behind you.
item.crossfire.name: Crossfire
item.crossfire.unique: Projectile hits spawn a free magic arrow aimed at the target, at most once every 2 seconds; cooldown reduction shortens that gap.
item.crude_feather.description: A ragged gray feather, bent and speckled with dirt.
item.crude_feather.lore: Plucked from some island bird that did not appreciate it. Lightweight and unremarkable, much like the bird's last moments.
item.crude_feather.name: Crude Feather
item.crude_feather.unique: Socket it into an empty slot on a piece of gear to add stats to that item.
item.crusader_helmet.description: A steel helm with a flat face plate, a narrow eye slit, and a faded painted cross.
item.crusader_helmet.lore: The resort's owner collected weird antiques. This was the only one that actually helped.
item.crusader_helmet.name: Crusader Helmet
item.cube_fragment_pendant.description: A shard of impossible black glass wrapped in copper wire, always slightly colder than the room.
item.cube_fragment_pendant.lore: Hold it up to the light and it throws a shadow that faces the wrong way.
item.cube_fragment_pendant.name: Cube Fragment Pendant
item.cube_fragment_pendant.unique: Blink detonates where you arrive, and its blast deals 2 more times spell damage.
item.cube_shard.description: A smooth black chip, angles slightly off, colder than the room.
item.cube_shard.lore: Look into it and you see a room you've never been in, and yourself in it, looking back.
item.cube_shard.name: Cube Shard
item.cult_ritual_liturgy.description: A rolled strip of tanned skin covered in tight, rhythmic script.
item.cult_ritual_liturgy.lore: Read it aloud and the lights go out. Read it silently and the lights come back on, a few at a time, in the wrong rooms.
item.cult_ritual_liturgy.name: Cult Ritual Liturgy
item.cult_ritual_liturgy.unique: Black Hole lasts 4 s longer, has +5 m radius and +10 pull force.
item.cult_sacrament_wafer.description: A thin gray wafer pressed with a closed eye.
item.cult_sacrament_wafer.lore: It dissolves on the tongue like ash, and leaves a quiet where the thoughts used to be.
item.cult_sacrament_wafer.name: Cult Sacrament Wafer
item.cult_sacrament_wafer.unique: Consume to restore a large amount of energy.
item.cultists_bone_epaulets.description: Fanned rib bones lashed to leather straps, painted with a faded eye.
item.cultists_bone_epaulets.lore: A mark of rank in the cult. The higher you climb, the more ribs you are missing.
item.cultists_bone_epaulets.name: Cultist's Bone Epaulets
item.curse_hammer.description: A black iron hammer covered in scratched warding symbols that did not work.
item.curse_hammer.lore: Every hand that held it learned how to hate. The symbols were not a warning; they were a recipe.
item.curse_hammer.name: Curse Hammer
item.curse_hammer.unique: Adds +45% chance to weaken enemies on hit.
item.cursed_resort_key_ring.description: A ring of keys to every room in the resort, all of them labeled 'DO NOT USE.'
item.cursed_resort_key_ring.lore: Every door opens, but it never opens onto the room you wanted. Occasionally it opens onto loot.
item.cursed_resort_key_ring.name: Cursed Resort Key Ring
item.cursed_resort_key_ring.unique: +25% magic find, but enemies are 10% more likely to land hits on you.
item.damaged_army_boots.description: Military boots with a split heel and a faded stencil on the tongue.
item.damaged_army_boots.lore: Pulled from a bunker locker that had been shut for years. Someone left in a hurry and took only one pair of socks.
item.damaged_army_boots.name: Damaged Army Boots
item.damaged_bracer.description: A cracked leather wrist guard held together with wire and optimism.
item.damaged_bracer.lore: It has taken more hits than anyone wearing it should admit. It will take a few more before it joins the others in the snow.
item.damaged_bracer.name: Damaged Bracer
item.damaged_leather_boots.description: Scuffed leather boots, torn at the toe but still holding a decent stride.
item.damaged_leather_boots.lore: Cut from a hide that was never meant to be shoes. They squeak in the snow, which the cannibals find hilarious right up until they don't.
item.damaged_leather_boots.name: Damaged Leather Boots
item.dark_oak_shield.description: A dense, dark oak shield with a scorched rim and a reinforced iron spine.
item.dark_oak_shield.lore: The wood came from a tree that stood alone on a ridge. It refuses to splinter, as if it still resents being cut.
item.dark_oak_shield.name: Dark Oak Shield
item.death_pact.description: Blood-red pauldrons carved with a ring of skulls, their eye sockets weeping fresh wax.
item.death_pact.lore: A deal is a deal. The more it costs you, the harder you hit back, and the pauldrons are very good at keeping count.
item.death_pact.name: Death Pact
item.death_pact.unique: Each attack costs 7% of your max health, though it cannot kill you; you gain 5% damage for every 1% of health you are missing.
item.demoman_s_vest.description: A canvas vest crammed with pouches of powder, fuses and mysterious wires.
item.demoman_s_vest.lore: Its owner knew everything about blasts and nothing about caution. He is the reason the vest is lighter than it should be.
item.demoman_s_vest.name: Demoman's Vest
item.destroyed_void_shard.description: A cracked black shard hanging from a cord, split down the middle.
item.destroyed_void_shard.lore: Something once held a piece of the void in this crystal. It broke. The void is still working, just sloppier.
item.destroyed_void_shard.name: Destroyed Void Shard
item.destroyed_void_shard.unique: Each melee or ranged hit reduces the remaining cooldown of one of your abilities by 1 second.
item.diamond_pendant_of_agility.descript: A diamond pendant sliced into a perfect arrowhead and strung on a hair-thin chain.
item.diamond_pendant_of_agility.lore: It weighs almost nothing, and so does everything else when you wear it. Some say the wearer outruns their own shadow.
item.diamond_pendant_of_agility.name: Diamond Pendant of Agility
item.diamond_pendant_of_intelligence.des: A flawless diamond pendant that bends light into tiny, patient constellations.
item.diamond_pendant_of_intelligence.lor: Stare long enough and the facets begin to show you answers. The stone never says which questions you are asking.
item.diamond_pendant_of_strength.descrip: A fist-sized diamond pendant on a chain of blackened iron links.
item.diamond_pendant_of_strength.lore: Cut from a stone that survived a crushing weight. It passes the habit along, and the wearer's grip tends to follow suit.
item.diamond_pendant_of_strength.name: Diamond Pendant of Strength
item.diamond_pendant_of_vitality.descrip: A clear diamond pendant that glimmers like fresh frost and warms like a hearth.
item.diamond_pendant_of_vitality.lore: It does not just keep you alive. It argues with death about the terms, and wins more often than not.
item.diamond_pendant_of_vitality.name: Diamond Pendant of Vitality
item.discounted_knockoff_magic_quiver.de: A cheap quiver stitched from leftover canvas with a faint, unconvincing glow.
item.discounted_knockoff_magic_quiver.lo: Sold by a tribal trader who swore it was the real thing. The arrows seem to agree about half the time.
item.discounted_knockoff_magic_quiver.un: 15% chance not to consume ammo when firing a projectile.
item.doom_pauldrons.description: Spiked iron pauldrons with a bleak ridge of black enamel along the edge.
item.doom_pauldrons.lore: Worn by a cult enforcer who saw an end coming and decided to arrive in style. He did.
item.doom_pauldrons.name: Doom Pauldrons
item.dull_axe.description: A chipped, dull axe that hits more like a stubborn hammer.
item.dull_axe.lore: Every survivor starts here. It cannot cut much, but it will teach you why you want a better one.
item.dull_axe.name: Dull Axe
item.dull_longsword.description: A longsword with a chipped, rounded edge that has seen far more use than care.
item.dull_longsword.lore: Sharp enough to be rude, dull enough to be bad at it. It remains a sword, and a sword is more than a stick.
item.dull_longsword.name: Dull Longsword
item.elite_stomach_acid.description: A stoppered flask of bright, glowing acid that eats through the cork slowly.
item.elite_stomach_acid.lore: Taken from an elite beast that ate something it shouldn't have. Now it forgives what the world couldn't.
item.elite_stomach_acid.name: Elite Stomach Acid
item.elite_stomach_acid.unique: Flips every negative stat value on an item into a positive one.
item.ember_mask.description: A bone-white mask whose eyeholes glow like coals.
item.ember_mask.lore: It never cools. The tribes say it holds a dying star, and the star is very hungry.
item.ember_mask.name: Ember Mask
item.ember_mask.unique: Ignited enemies burn 700% longer, and burn damage ticks 300% faster.
item.emerald_pendant_of_agility.descript: A slim emerald pendant shaped like a leaping stag, strung on a bright chain.
item.emerald_pendant_of_agility.lore: Fast enough to be a rumor and quiet enough to stay one. It is the gem of choice for those who prefer not to be seen reaching.
item.emerald_pendant_of_agility.name: Emerald Pendant of Agility
item.emerald_pendant_of_intelligence.des: A teardrop emerald pendant that glows brighter whenever you cast a spell.
item.emerald_pendant_of_intelligence.lor: The gem is flawless, which no emerald has any right to be. Casters call it a lens, skeptics call it a leash, and the stone stays quiet about it.
item.emerald_pendant_of_strength.descrip: A heavy emerald pendant carved with a bull's head and strung on a thick gold chain.
item.emerald_pendant_of_strength.lore: Wealthy owners wore it to the resort's wrestling nights. The emerald is real, the bull is a metaphor, and the nose of the last loser is a trophy.
item.emerald_pendant_of_strength.name: Emerald Pendant of Strength
item.emerald_pendant_of_vitality.descrip: An emerald pendant cut like a heart, glowing a faint, living green.
item.emerald_pendant_of_vitality.lore: It is cool on a hot day and warm on a freezing one. Owners recover from things they have no business surviving.
item.emerald_pendant_of_vitality.name: Emerald Pendant of Vitality
item.enchanted_moonstone.description: A glowing silver-white gem that hums quietly at night.
item.enchanted_moonstone.lore: The hum follows the phase of the moon, and so, the cult claims, do certain things in the deep caves.
item.enchanted_moonstone.name: Enchanted Moonstone
item.enchanted_moonstone.unique: Socket it into an empty slot on a piece of gear to add stats to that item.
item.enchanted_sapphire.description: A bright blue gem with a slow pulse of light deep inside.
item.enchanted_sapphire.lore: The pulse matches no heartbeat you know. Keep it in a pocket and it sometimes seems to tug toward the caves.
item.enchanted_sapphire.name: Enchanted Sapphire
item.enchanted_sapphire.unique: Socket it into an empty slot on a piece of gear to add stats to that item.
item.enzyme_agi_39.description: A sealed vial of thin, bright green liquid that ripples constantly.
item.enzyme_agi_39.lore: Bunker lab label: AGILITY. The tech was last seen sprinting away from his own experiment.
item.enzyme_agi_39.name: Enzyme AGI/39
item.enzyme_agi_39.unique: Converts a Vitality, Intelligence or Strength stat on an item into Agility, or a Melee or Spell damage stat into Ranged Damage.
item.enzyme_int_33.description: A sealed vial of shimmering, pale blue liquid that moves on its own.
item.enzyme_int_33.lore: Bunker lab label: INTELLECT. The tech who wrote it looks to have dropped it, then gone looking for it.
item.enzyme_int_33.name: Enzyme INT/33
item.enzyme_int_33.unique: Converts a Vitality, Agility or Strength stat on an item into Intelligence, or a Ranged or Melee damage stat into Spell Damage.
item.enzyme_str_34.description: A sealed vial of thick, crimson liquid with a faint metallic smell.
item.enzyme_str_34.lore: Bunker lab label: STRENGTH. Someone scribbled 'do not drink' under it, then crossed out 'drink'.
item.enzyme_str_34.name: Enzyme STR/34
item.enzyme_str_34.unique: Converts a Vitality, Agility or Intelligence stat on an item into Strength, or a Ranged or Spell damage stat into Melee Damage.
item.enzyme_vit_449.description: A sealed vial of thick, dark amber liquid that smells faintly of broth.
item.enzyme_vit_449.lore: Bunker lab label: VITALITY. It is the only one they ever tested on a living subject. The subject is still around.
item.enzyme_vit_449.name: Enzyme VIT/449
item.enzyme_vit_449.unique: Converts an Agility, Intelligence or Strength stat on an item into Vitality.
item.eruption.description: A greatbow of volcanic glass and dark wood, hot to the touch.
item.eruption.lore: Carved from a rock that exploded when it was cut. The bow has never seen a target it did not want to crack open.
item.eruption.name: Eruption
item.etched_mantle.description: A thin cloth mantle covered in fine silver etchings that crawl when you look away.
item.etched_mantle.lore: Each etching is a small spell, bound into the weave by a very patient and very unhinged tailor.
item.etched_mantle.name: Etched Mantle
item.explosive_touch.description: Charred gloves with red rune-marks across the palms and fingertips.
item.explosive_touch.lore: Shake hands with someone while wearing these, and the conversation ends quickly, and loudly.
item.explosive_touch.name: Explosive Touch
item.eyepatch.description: A black cloth eyepatch with a fraying strap and a small brass stud.
item.eyepatch.lore: A survivor's second-best option after losing the first. It makes you look tough and feel nothing, which is how it was meant.
item.eyepatch.name: Eyepatch
item.eyepatch.unique: Explosion damage also applies when you perform jump attacks.
item.factory_quiver.description: A sleek, matte-black quiver stamped with a serial number and a bunker logo.
item.factory_quiver.lore: Printed in one piece at a 3D fabricator deep in the complex. The ammo feeder was not part of the original design.
item.factory_quiver.name: Factory Quiver
item.factory_quiver.unique: 40% chance not to consume ammo when firing a projectile.
item.famine_hammer.description: A crude stone-headed hammer on a short femur handle.
item.famine_hammer.lore: The tribes carved it in a winter when nothing grew and nobody ate. It hits like an empty stomach.
item.famine_hammer.name: Famine Hammer
item.famine_hammer.unique: Adds +30% chance to weaken enemies on hit.
item.fate_boots.description: Black boots with silver-threaded seams and soles that leave no tracks.
item.fate_boots.lore: They show up where you stop and look. Wear them long enough and your path starts to feel pre-written.
item.fate_boots.name: Fate Boots
item.fate_gloves.description: Dark gloves stitched with silver thread in a pattern that rearranges when you look away.
item.fate_gloves.lore: They were found sitting on a rock near the golf course, neatly folded. Nobody left them there, and nobody has claimed them.
item.fate_gloves.name: Fate Gloves
item.finger_warmer.description: A knitted fingerless mitt with one thumb hole chewed bigger than the rest.
item.finger_warmer.lore: Warm enough for a pilot's hands and useless against everything else. Still better than frostbite, which takes fingers just as thoroughly as the locals do.
item.finger_warmer.name: Finger Warmer
item.fire_hardened_spear.description: A straight sapling sharpened to a point and baked in a campfire.
item.fire_hardened_spear.lore: Humanity's first technology. It still works.
item.fire_hardened_spear.name: Fire-Hardened Spear
item.fists_of_nails.description: Heavy gloves with long rusted nails hammered through the knuckles from the inside out.
item.fists_of_nails.lore: The wearer never explained how they put them on. Everyone nearby agreed it was not a topic to push.
item.fists_of_nails.name: Fists of Nails
item.fists_of_nails.unique: You gain 9 thorns per point of vitality.
item.flame_pauldrons.description: Charred steel pauldrons with ever-burning brass vents on the shoulder.
item.flame_pauldrons.lore: Built to turn heat into fury. The inner lining is mostly scar tissue now.
item.flame_pauldrons.name: Flame Pauldrons
item.flame_pauldrons.unique: Firebolt costs 5 more energy and its damage scaling increases by 7.5.
item.forbidden_scroll.description: A black scroll sealed with red wax and labeled in four languages with the same word: no.
item.forbidden_scroll.lore: The cult wrote it and then tried to burn it. Half the scroll is missing, and the missing half is the worst part.
item.forbidden_scroll.name: Forbidden Scroll
item.frost_giant.description: A massive hammer with an ice-crusted head the size of a boot.
item.frost_giant.lore: Carried down from the peaks by a mutant that had apparently been standing in a glacier. It never thaws, and neither does the grudge.
item.frost_giant.name: Frost Giant
item.frost_giant.unique: Hammer hits freeze enemies instead of stunning them, and the freeze lasts twice as long.
item.frostbound_wristguard.description: A wristguard of riveted plates rimed with frost that never quite melts.
item.frostbound_wristguard.lore: Pulled off a frozen hand on the northern ridge. The hand had been holding on to something that was no longer there.
item.frostbound_wristguard.name: Frostbound Wristguard
item.frozen_kite_shield.description: A kite-shaped shield caked with permafrost that does not melt, even near fire.
item.frozen_kite_shield.lore: Dug out of a drift. The winter that left it behind is not finished with you.
item.frozen_kite_shield.name: Frozen Kite Shield
item.frozen_kite_shield.unique: Blizzard slows you less, magic damage taken is 15% lower, Snap Freeze lasts 3 s longer.
item.full_metal_sword.description: A massive greatsword forged in one piece of steel, tip to pommel, with no wood anywhere.
item.full_metal_sword.lore: Too heavy for a normal swing, so someone built a bigger person to swing it. That person did not come back for it, which tells you how the story ended.
item.full_metal_sword.name: Full Metal Sword
item.giant_polearm.description: A huge polearm with a broad blade as long as a forearm.
item.giant_polearm.lore: A tribal heavy carried this like a toothpick. Most survivors need both hands and a prayer.
item.giant_polearm.name: Giant Polearm
item.gliderwing_mantle.description: Stiff ribbed fabric stretched across a shoulder frame, scavenged from a wrecked glider.
item.gliderwing_mantle.lore: It does not make you fly. It makes you believe, for a few seconds, that you could.
item.gliderwing_mantle.name: Gliderwing Mantle
item.gliderwing_mantle.unique: +1.5 jump power, +15% movement speed and +10 m Blink range.
item.golden_axe_of_fortune.description: A gleaming axe plated in gold, the edge as bright as a coin in firelight.
item.golden_axe_of_fortune.lore: Rumor says the resort's owner commissioned it for a photo. The photo never ran, but the axe found plenty of work.
item.golden_axe_of_fortune.name: Golden Axe of Fortune
item.golden_cuirass.description: A suit of gleaming golden plate, strangely light and lined with a sweet-smelling resin.
item.golden_cuirass.lore: Whoever forged it never needed a forge. The seams hum softly in the dark, as though the metal were counting.
item.golden_cuirass.name: Golden Cuirass
item.golden_gauntlets.description: Fingered gold gauntlets, impossibly smooth and just a little too warm to hold.
item.golden_gauntlets.lore: The old tales say gold does not tarnish. They fail to mention that it does not forget, either.
item.golden_gauntlets.name: Golden Gauntlets
item.golden_greaves.description: Segmented golden leg plates that chime softly with every step.
item.golden_greaves.lore: Walking in them feels like being carried. You feel less like a survivor and more like a procession.
item.golden_greaves.name: Golden Greaves
item.golden_locket.description: A small gold locket with a hairline crack and a faded photograph inside.
item.golden_locket.lore: The face in the photo is smiling at someone who was never going to reach it. It still closes with a soft, hopeful click.
item.golden_locket.name: Golden Locket
item.golden_locket_of_agility.descriptio: A light gold locket on a slender chain that never tangles or rattles.
item.golden_locket_of_agility.lore: Hunters wear it to forget the weight of their own bodies. It is easy to run when you feel like nothing is holding you down.
item.golden_locket_of_agility.name: Golden Locket of Agility
item.golden_locket_of_intelligence.descr: A gold locket etched with a spiral that appears to move if you stare at it.
item.golden_locket_of_intelligence.lore: The inside is a mirror, and it never shows your reflection exactly as you left it. Wearers say it is looking for a better version.
item.golden_locket_of_intelligence.name: Golden Locket of Intelligence
item.golden_locket_of_strength.descripti: A heavy gold locket on a thick chain, holding a tiny carving of a raised fist.
item.golden_locket_of_strength.lore: Inside is a lock of hair and a promise to come back. Somebody kept the promise, and somebody else kept the locket.
item.golden_locket_of_strength.name: Golden Locket of Strength
item.golden_locket_of_vitality.descripti: A gold locket that stays warm no matter how cold the night gets.
item.golden_locket_of_vitality.lore: Inside, a faded portrait of someone smiling. Wearing it makes dying feel rude.
item.golden_locket_of_vitality.name: Golden Locket of Vitality
item.golden_pauldrons.description: Sculpted golden shoulder guards shaped like closed eyelids.
item.golden_pauldrons.lore: They do not blink. If you stare long enough, you start to wonder who is wearing whom.
item.golden_pauldrons.name: Golden Pauldrons
item.golden_ring.description: A plain gold band, warm to the touch even in the snow.
item.golden_ring.lore: A resort guest's wedding ring, according to the engraving. Their finger did not come with it.
item.golden_ring.name: Golden Ring
item.golden_ring_of_agility.description: A slim gold ring shaped like a coiled snake, with tiny ruby eyes.
item.golden_ring_of_agility.lore: Its former owner was never caught, and never once seen to run. The ring is happy to take credit.
item.golden_ring_of_agility.name: Golden Ring of Agility
item.golden_ring_of_intelligence.descrip: A gold ring etched with tiny, restless runes that rearrange when you look away.
item.golden_ring_of_intelligence.lore: Wearers claim it whispers the answers just before the questions. The ones who listened longest started finishing your sentences.
item.golden_ring_of_intelligence.name: Golden Ring of Intelligence
item.golden_ring_of_strength.description: A heavy gold band engraved with a clenched fist and a ring of knuckles.
item.golden_ring_of_strength.lore: Some owners wore it to win arguments. It won them anyway, and then it won the next fight, and the next, until the arguments stopped.
item.golden_ring_of_strength.name: Golden Ring of Strength
item.golden_ring_of_vitality.description: A warm gold ring set with a ruby that pulses like a slow heartbeat.
item.golden_ring_of_vitality.lore: The ruby is not a ruby. It brightens whenever its wearer is close to dying and dims once they decide not to.
item.golden_ring_of_vitality.name: Golden Ring of Vitality
item.golden_tooth.description: A gold-capped molar, still attached to a little piece of jaw.
item.golden_tooth.lore: Taken from a tribe leader or a lucky hiker. No one can say which.
item.golden_tooth.name: Golden Tooth
item.golden_visage.description: A blank, polished golden mask that reflects only the face of the person who is about to die.
item.golden_visage.lore: Found sealed in a case under the hills, a warm hand-print still on the glass. Taking it off feels like telling the island you give up.
item.golden_visage.name: Golden Visage
item.gps_locator_visor.description: A sleek bunker-issue visor that paints a shaky green grid over everything it sees.
item.gps_locator_visor.lore: Every enemy gets a little crosshair and a timestamp. The timestamps are all in the near future.
item.gps_locator_visor.name: GPS Locator Visor
item.great_white_shark_tooth.description: A palm-sized triangular tooth with a razor edge and a yellowed root.
item.great_white_shark_tooth.lore: Found lodged in a hull plank. The boat sank, and the tooth is the only survivor that bragged about it.
item.great_white_shark_tooth.name: Great White Shark Tooth
item.great_white_shark_tooth.unique: Socket it into an empty slot on a piece of gear to add stats to that item.
item.greatbow.description: A heavy wooden bow nearly as tall as the person drawing it.
item.greatbow.lore: A tribal design that favors range over manners. Every arrow whistles on the way out, which is part of the fun.
item.greatbow.name: Greatbow
item.greater_mutated_heart.description: A fat, pulsing heart the size of a fist, wrapped in veins that twitch on their own.
item.greater_mutated_heart.lore: It beat in something that should not have lived. Whatever it was changed along the way, and the change is now yours if you can stomach it.
item.greater_mutated_heart.name: Greater Mutated Heart
item.greater_mutated_heart.unique: Right-click to consume it and gain permanent perk points.
item.greed.description: Gold-plated boots with spiked toes and a cheap, tacky shine.
item.greed.lore: Pulled off a resort investor who kept grabbing for more and finally reached too far. The boots still do.
item.greed.name: Greed
item.greed.unique: Automatically casts Wide Reach once every second.
item.grip_of_sora.description: Slim bracers of woven cord and steel clasps, built to hold a bow steady.
item.grip_of_sora.lore: A hunter's tools, found with the owner's hands still in them. The cord is fresh. The hands are not.
item.grip_of_sora.name: Grip of Sora
item.grip_of_sora.unique: Multishot costs 20% less energy and fires 4 extra projectiles, and the extras add no energy cost.
item.guardian.description: An ornate shield with a watching eye embossed in the center.
item.guardian.lore: The eye follows whoever carries it. After a while you realize it follows you back.
item.guardian.name: Guardian
item.guide_on_tearing_spacetime.descript: A thick, hand-bound manual with diagrams of folded space.
item.guide_on_tearing_spacetime.lore: Written by someone who believed distance was a suggestion. The last chapter is mostly crossed out and underlined.
item.guide_on_tearing_spacetime.name: Guide on Tearing Spacetime
item.guide_on_tearing_spacetime.unique: Blink creates an explosion where you arrive, with damage scaling with your speed and radius scaling with the blink distance.
item.gun_blade.description: A short axe with a pistol grip welded to the haft, firing straight through the head.
item.gun_blade.lore: A bunker armorer's idea of efficiency. The axe is mostly for show. The pistol is not.
item.gun_blade.name: Gun Blade
item.gunpowder_boxers.description: Cotton boxers sewn with tiny pouches of powder along the seams.
item.gunpowder_boxers.lore: Nobody asked who made them or why, and nobody wanted to know. They are very warm, though.
item.gunpowder_boxers.name: Gunpowder Boxers
item.gunpowder_filled_socks.description: Thick wool socks packed with black powder in all the wrong places.
item.gunpowder_filled_socks.lore: Somebody's idea of a boot upgrade. Walk softly, and do not stand near a campfire.
item.gunpowder_filled_socks.name: Gunpowder filled socks
item.hammer_jammers.description: Armored trousers with metal plates along the thighs and a pair of hammer loops at the belt.
item.hammer_jammers.lore: A craftsman's joke made real: they make you bring the hammer down harder and then hold the line when the dust settles.
item.hammer_jammers.name: Hammer Jammers
item.hammer_jammers.unique: Smash attacks deal 4.5 times damage, and your hammer stun duration is doubled.
item.hand_held_ballista.description: A stubby, over-engineered crossbow of steel and wire, as long as an arm.
item.hand_held_ballista.lore: A siege weapon shrunk down by someone with more courage than sense. It kicks like a mule with a grudge.
item.hand_held_ballista.name: Hand-held Ballista
item.hand_of_the_cube.description: A gauntlet of seamless dark metal, covered in angles that don't quite add up.
item.hand_of_the_cube.lore: It fits every hand. It fits no one. Look at it for too long and your fingers feel like a different shape.
item.hand_of_the_cube.name: Hand of the Cube
item.hand_of_the_cube.unique: Spells recharge 20% faster and cost 15% less, but maximum health is 15% lower.
item.hazard_s_gear.description: A reinforced hazard harness stitched with warning tape and scorch marks.
item.hazard_s_gear.lore: Hazard was a nickname, then a warning, then a legend. The gear is sewn for speed, and every singe on it matches a story nobody finished.
item.hazard_s_gear.name: Hazard's Gear
item.healer_s_bracers.description: Soft bracers padded with moss and stitched gauze, smelling faintly of antiseptic.
item.healer_s_bracers.lore: Taken from a medic who treated everyone, friend or enemy. The island rewarded this the way it rewards everything.
item.healer_s_bracers.name: Healer's Bracers
item.healer_s_gloves.description: Clean cloth gloves stained at the fingertips with old iodine and darker things.
item.healer_s_gloves.lore: The medic who wore these never washed them fast enough. Somehow, they still feel like a promise to someone.
item.healer_s_gloves.name: Healer's Gloves
item.heart_of_purity.description: A clear, softly glowing heart, free of any blemish or mutation, beating without a body.
item.heart_of_purity.lore: Everything on this island is tainted, which makes this the strangest thing you have found. It pulses slowly, as though waiting for permission.
item.heart_of_purity.name: Heart of Purity
item.heavy_shoulder_plates.description: Massive steel shoulder plates fitted with spikes and a dozen buckles.
item.heavy_shoulder_plates.lore: Pauldrons for someone who does not think of himself as a target, but as a weapon with feet.
item.heavy_shoulder_plates.name: Heavy Shoulder Plates
item.hexed_pants_of_mr_m.description: Charcoal-black pants stitched with a thin, unfriendly thread that wriggles under your gaze.
item.hexed_pants_of_mr_m.lore: Mr M. never stopped walking, because the pants never let him. They have a sharp opinion on loitering and no patience at all for sitting.
item.hexed_pants_of_mr_m.name: Hexed Pants of Mr M.
item.hexed_pants_of_mr_m.unique: While moving you gain 40% more energy regeneration and damage. After standing still for over a second you lose 1% of max health per second.
item.hide_takers_gloves.description: Fingerless leather gloves with skinning blades stitched along the knuckles.
item.hide_takers_gloves.lore: The pelts stay on the hooks until the island hands them back, uncomfortable and full of opinions.
item.hide_takers_gloves.name: Hide-Taker's Gloves
item.hollow_congregant_cowl.description: A grey linen cowl with the eyes stitched shut from the inside.
item.hollow_congregant_cowl.lore: Members wear it to stop looking at the world. Whoever sewed these shut was thorough, and apparently left-handed.
item.hollow_congregant_cowl.name: Hollow Congregant's Cowl
item.hollow_log.description: A hollowed-out tree trunk fitted with a leather strap, packed with fletched arrows.
item.hollow_log.lore: The bark is still on. Something small and furious lived in it before you, and some of that mood lingers in the shots you take.
item.hollow_log.name: Hollow Log
item.hood.description: A coarse dark hood stitched from burlap and wool, deep enough to hide a face.
item.hood.lore: Survivors favor these for staying inconspicuous. Unfortunately, so do the cannibals.
item.hood.name: Hood
item.hood.unique: Like all headgear, it carries stat bonuses.
item.hood_2.description: A coarse cloth hood that keeps the snow off your neck.
item.hood_2.lore: Warm, ugly, and it hides your face from things that hunt by sight. Good enough for winter.
item.hood_2.name: Hood
item.horned_helmet.description: A dented steel helmet with two curved horns bolted on by someone who wanted to look scarier.
item.horned_helmet.lore: Found on a cannibal who did not need the help. The horns were glued on with something brown, and nobody has asked what.
item.horned_helmet.name: Horned Helmet
item.horned_helmet_2.description: A battered iron helmet with a pair of curved horns.
item.horned_helmet_2.lore: Worn by tribal heavies who believed bigger was better. The horns, at least, agreed.
item.horned_helmet_2.name: Horned Helmet
item.hubble_s_vision.description: A helmet fitted with a cracked lens that stares out at things you cannot see.
item.hubble_s_vision.lore: Whoever wore it looked too long into the dark between stars and the dark looked back. The lens still pulls at nearby light, and sometimes at nearby people.
item.hubble_s_vision.name: Hubble's Vision
item.ice_scroll.description: A frost-rimed scroll whose ink creeps across the page like slow ice.
item.ice_scroll.lore: Dug out of a frozen cave where the walls sweat cold. The last reader is still in there, politely standing very still.
item.ice_scroll.name: Ice Scroll
item.ice_scroll.unique: Snap Freeze deals more damage and its slow lasts 2 seconds longer.
item.improved_magic_quiver.description: A quiver of black leather wrapped with silver wire and tiny runes.
item.improved_magic_quiver.lore: Someone with too much free time kept improving it. The arrows keep coming, and they don't look happy about it.
item.improved_magic_quiver.name: Improved Magic Quiver
item.improved_magic_quiver.unique: 25% chance not to consume ammo when firing a projectile.
item.iron_boots.description: Heavy boots with iron toe-caps and clinking buckles.
item.iron_boots.lore: Loud and slow, but nothing stomps a mutant's skull better.
item.iron_boots.name: Iron Boots
item.iron_breastplate.description: A thick iron chest plate hammered into shape by someone in a hurry.
item.iron_breastplate.lore: The dents are from earlier owners. The blood is from later ones.
item.iron_breastplate.name: Iron Breastplate
item.iron_gauntlet.description: A single iron gauntlet, rough and heavy, built to take hits as well as give them.
item.iron_gauntlet.lore: Forged by a survivor with a forge made of scraps, and more fury than patience. It fits poorly and hits very well.
item.iron_gauntlet.name: Iron Gauntlet
item.iron_gauntlet_2.description: A clunky iron glove with riveted finger plates.
item.iron_gauntlet_2.lore: Built for punching through doors, and anything standing behind them.
item.iron_gauntlet_2.name: Iron Gauntlet
item.iron_helmet.description: A plain round iron helmet with a nose guard.
item.iron_helmet.lore: The dents prove it works. The dent shapes prove who it worked on.
item.iron_helmet.name: Iron Helmet
item.iron_horn.description: A curved iron horn on a leather cord, battered but still capable of a deep, resonant note.
item.iron_horn.lore: Its call used to rally soldiers who didn't have the luxury of a plan. Something on this island heard it and decided to join in.
item.iron_horn.name: Iron Horn
item.iron_horn.unique: When you use Warcry, you and your allies gain bonus armor equal to 10% of your armor.
item.iron_plate_full_of_holes.descriptio: A rusted iron plate pierced with dozens of neat holes, strapped to a canvas harness.
item.iron_plate_full_of_holes.lore: A cult smith punched it full of holes for reasons no one can remember. It is the least protective armor on the island and the most open-minded.
item.iron_plate_full_of_holes.name: Iron plate full of holes
item.iron_shield.description: A round iron shield dented in a few places and hammered back in others.
item.iron_shield.lore: Made from a hospital cart's tray and many patient hours.
item.iron_shield.name: Iron Shield
item.iron_shoulder_pads.description: Riveted iron plates that sit on the shoulders like small anvils.
item.iron_shoulder_pads.lore: Forged in a hurry from resort railings. They still have flecks of paint on them.
item.iron_shoulder_pads.name: Iron Shoulder Pads
item.iron_tasset.description: Overlapping iron plates hung from a wide belt.
item.iron_tasset.lore: They rattle as you walk, which warns your enemies. Most don't use the warning.
item.iron_tasset.name: Iron Tasset
item.iron_wristguard.description: A hinged iron wristguard on a leather strap.
item.iron_wristguard.lore: Stops blades and breaks bones, preferably in that order.
item.iron_wristguard.name: Iron Wristguard
item.jagged_edge.description: An axe with a saw-toothed blade, every tooth a different shape and size.
item.jagged_edge.lore: Made by a butcher who saw no reason to be neat. It leaves wounds that do not stop talking.
item.jagged_edge.name: Jagged Edge
item.jagged_edge.unique: Bash has a 30% chance to make enemies bleed for 30% of the damage dealt per second, lasting as long as the slow.
item.javelin.description: A balanced throwing spear with a sharpened bone tip and a leather grip.
item.javelin.lore: Cannibal hunters throw them with unsettling grace. Yours will do the same, once you work out which end to hold.
item.javelin.name: Javelin
item.jihad_vest.description: A canvas vest packed with powder charges and a crude pull-cord.
item.jihad_vest.lore: Worn by a cult zealot who believed in going out loud. The cord is intentionally easy to find.
item.jihad_vest.name: Zealot's Powder Vest
item.keycard_bracer.description: A wrist rig of clipped-together keycards, most of them for doors that no longer exist.
item.keycard_bracer.lore: Level 4 clearance, expired. Level 6 clearance, scratched out. Level 9, stained a very specific brown.
item.keycard_bracer.name: Keycard Bracer
item.king_qruies.description: A broad sword with a crown-shaped pommel and a nick at the tip from the last thing it killed.
item.king_qruies.lore: It wants to be used by someone who gets hurt a lot. Take a hit, and the blade adds the pain to its next swing.
item.king_qruies.name: Grudgeblade
item.king_qruies.unique: You gain melee damage equal to the last physical damage you took.
item.knife_on_a_stick.description: A big hunting knife lashed to a long pole with duct tape and stubbornness.
item.knife_on_a_stick.lore: The oldest trick in the book, upgraded by someone who did it in the dark with cold hands. It still works the first time, every time.
item.knife_on_a_stick.name: Knife on a stick
item.knucklebone_choker.description: A choker of finger bones, still strung on fishing line.
item.knucklebone_choker.lore: Mutants have too many fingers anyway. Someone had to start counting the spares.
item.knucklebone_choker.name: Knucklebone Choker
item.kuldars_s_scarf.description: A thick, scratchy scarf of knotted wool in dull red and gray.
item.kuldars_s_scarf.lore: It belonged to a man who never took it off, not even indoors. The cold finds you anyway, but now it takes longer.
item.kuldars_s_scarf.name: Kuldars's Scarf
item.lama_mega_s_blood_bag.description: A bulging pouch of dark leather on a thick cord, tied shut with sinew.
item.lama_mega_s_blood_bag.lore: Lama Mega was a tribal healer who bled for everyone and then decided to make everyone bleed back.
item.lama_mega_s_blood_bag.name: Lama Mega's Blood Bag
item.lama_mega_s_blood_bag.unique: Melee hits cause bleeding that deals damage equal to 100% of your maximum life over 15 seconds.
item.lantern_skull_helm.description: A cannibal skull helm hollowed out to hold a flickering lantern behind the eye sockets.
item.lantern_skull_helm.lore: Cave raiders wore these to be seen coming. Not so much to scare the enemy as to find each other in the dark.
item.lantern_skull_helm.name: Lantern-Skull Helm
item.lantern_skull_helm.unique: Doubles flashlight brightness, cuts battery drain by 40%, and adds 3 m to Sun Flare radius.
item.lead_ore.description: A dull, heavy lump of gray metal that stains the fingers.
item.lead_ore.lore: Dug out of the ground near the bunkers, where it is nearly everywhere. Heavy, soft, and happy to be forgotten.
item.lead_ore.name: Lead Ore
item.lead_ore.unique: Socket it into an empty slot on a piece of gear to add stats to that item.
item.leather_bracer.description: A supple leather bracer, double-stitched with a hardened plate across the forearm.
item.leather_bracer.lore: Made by a patient hand with a good knife. It never shouts about what it can do, it just keeps your wrist where you left it.
item.leather_bracer.name: Leather Bracer
item.leather_jacket.description: A black leather jacket, scarred at the elbows and stiff from the cold.
item.leather_jacket.lore: Rides well, wipes clean, and makes a dramatic entrance. Blood comes off leather easier than you would hope.
item.leather_jacket.name: Leather Jacket
item.leather_mantle.description: A broad leather mantle worn across the shoulders, studded with brass rivets.
item.leather_mantle.lore: Equal parts armor and fashion. The studs give it weight, and the weight gives you a reason to hold your head high.
item.leather_mantle.name: Leather Mantle
item.leather_shoulder_armor.description: A stitched leather pauldron, curved to turn aside glancing hits.
item.leather_shoulder_armor.lore: Cheap, quick to repair, and quiet in the snow. Craftspeople like it because it forgives mistakes.
item.leather_shoulder_armor.name: Leather Shoulder Armor
item.leather_tasset.description: Hanging strips of boiled leather tied around the waist.
item.leather_tasset.lore: Cheap, comfy and barely decent. The tribes call it fashion.
item.leather_tasset.name: Leather Tasset
item.leather_vest.description: A sleeveless leather vest stitched with gut thread.
item.leather_vest.lore: The tribes wear them hunting. It stops a lot of small things and a few large ones.
item.leather_vest.name: Leather Vest
item.lesser_mutated_heart.description: A small, sickly heart that keeps beating long after it should have stopped.
item.lesser_mutated_heart.lore: Harvested from a mutant that lost interest in dying. The taste is exactly what you fear, and the lessons it teaches are real.
item.lesser_mutated_heart.name: Lesser Mutated Heart
item.lesser_mutated_heart.unique: Right-click to consume it and gain experience.
item.life_ring.description: A dull red ring that feels like a pulse against the skin.
item.life_ring.lore: Cut from something that was never meant to be cut. Wear it long enough and you stop noticing the second heartbeat.
item.life_ring.name: Life Ring
item.light_boot.description: Thin leather boots laced to the knee, cheap and quiet.
item.light_boot.lore: Made for people who want to leave quickly. The soles are mostly rumor.
item.light_boot.name: Light Boot
item.long_lost_quiver.description: A mud-caked quiver of fine leather, found in a place no one admits to visiting.
item.long_lost_quiver.lore: It belonged to a hunter who vanished mid-chase. The arrows inside are still fresh, and they still seem to be aimed at something.
item.long_lost_quiver.name: Long Lost Quiver
item.longbow_of_the_last_hunt.descriptio: A tall bow of pale, ash-dusted wood with a string that hums when no one touches it.
item.longbow_of_the_last_hunt.lore: Legend says the prey picks the hunter. The island seems to have set its mind on you.
item.longbow_of_the_last_hunt.name: Longbow of the Last Hunt
item.longbow_of_the_last_hunt.unique: Bow damage is 60% higher, true aim is active, and 30% of shots are not consumed.
item.longsword.description: A balanced steel longsword with a clean fuller and a cross guard worn smooth.
item.longsword.lore: Forged with care for someone who planned to use it well. Every nick along the blade is a conversation that ended in your favor.
item.longsword.name: Longsword
item.loop.description: A plain band of tarnished metal, polished smooth by years on someone's finger.
item.loop.lore: Rings have a way of surviving their owners. This one has already survived at least three.
item.loop.name: Loop
item.madman_s_legacy.description: A scarred round shield with a face scratched into it, grinning and screaming.
item.madman_s_legacy.lore: Passed from one madman to the next. Each added a line to the face. The face now has plenty of lines.
item.madman_s_legacy.name: Madman's Legacy
item.madman_s_legacy.unique: Frenzy deals +69% more damage per stack.
item.maga_cap.description: A faded red baseball cap with stiff stitching and a sweat-stained brim.
item.maga_cap.lore: Left in the resort lobby beside an empty champagne flute. It makes you feel strangely confident and a little bit sunburned.
item.maga_cap.name: MAGA Cap
item.magefist.description: A thick armored glove with rune-etched knuckles that flare when clenched.
item.magefist.lore: The runes are an overcharge, a bad idea scribbled onto steel. Power rises fast, and so does the bill.
item.magefist.name: Magefist
item.magefist.unique: Your spells deal double damage and cost double energy.
item.magic_quiver.description: A leather quiver sewn with silver thread that never quite empties.
item.magic_quiver.lore: You reach in and there is always another arrow. Don't ask who put it there.
item.magic_quiver.name: Magic Quiver
item.magic_quiver.unique: 20% chance not to consume ammo when firing a projectile.
item.magus_necktie.description: A black silk necktie with a silver pin in the shape of an eye.
item.magus_necktie.lore: A bunker magus wore it to interrogate captives. It still knows how to tighten.
item.magus_necktie.name: Magus' Necktie
item.mana_ring.description: A thin silver ring with a milky blue stone that hums when held near your ear.
item.mana_ring.lore: The stone pulses in time with your breathing. Kelvin cannot hear it, and says that is the only reason he still wears his own.
item.mana_ring.name: Mana Ring
item.mask.description: A carved wooden face mask, rough-cut and streaked with dried paint.
item.mask.lore: The tribes wear them to hide who is under them. Put one on and the woods watch you a little differently.
item.mask.name: Mask
item.mask_of_madness.description: A bone-white mask with a grin carved too wide and eyeholes that never quite line up.
item.mask_of_madness.lore: The cult sold these as visions on demand. The visions came, the buyers did not stop talking, and the talking never made sense.
item.mask_of_madness.name: Mask of Madness
item.maximale_qualit_t.description: A flawless ring stamped with a tiny German inscription that glints a bit too smugly.
item.maximale_qualit_t.lore: Precision-engineered and utterly sure of itself. It was found in the buried complex, in a box labeled with a name nobody can pronounce the same way twice.
item.maximale_qualit_t.name: Maximale Qualität
item.megalodon_s_tooth.description: A huge, ancient tooth as long as a hand, black with age and heavy as stone.
item.megalodon_s_tooth.lore: Something this big should not be alive. Something this big should not be dead, either, and yet here is its tooth.
item.megalodon_s_tooth.name: Megalodon's Tooth
item.megalodon_s_tooth.unique: Socket it into an empty slot on a piece of gear to add stats to that item.
item.megan_s_locket.description: A small tarnished locket with a cracked clasp and a ribbon of faded pink.
item.megan_s_locket.lore: Inside is a child's drawing of a family that stopped being a family a long time ago. The locket refuses to be thrown away, and so far it has not been.
item.megan_s_locket.name: Keepsake Locket
item.minibar_whiskey.description: A tiny bottle from the resort minibar. The seal is intact. This is a miracle.
item.minibar_whiskey.lore: Priced at fifteen dollars. Currently priceless.
item.minibar_whiskey.name: Minibar Whiskey
item.minibar_whiskey.unique: Consume to restore life and stamina, and briefly steady your aim.
item.moon_boots.description: Puffy silver boots with springy soles, as if built for a lower-gravity world.
item.moon_boots.lore: Left in a locker in the buried complex, labeled with a code and a smiley face. Every step feels like the ground is a polite suggestion.
item.moon_boots.name: Moon Boots
item.moon_cuirass.description: Chest armor of pale silver plates that glow softly even under heavy cloud.
item.moon_cuirass.lore: Found in a high cave whose roof was open to the sky. A bow lay beside it, strung, and nobody has dared ask what it was waiting for.
item.moon_cuirass.name: Moon Cuirass
item.moon_cuirass.unique: A headshot with an arrow lacking Seeking Arrow's homing, from more than 120 feet away, deals five times damage and hits two extra times.
item.moonwalkers.description: Scuffed rubber boots with soles worn smooth on one side.
item.moonwalkers.lore: Whoever made these thought walking forward was overrated. You will feel the same, after you back off a cliff.
item.moonwalkers.name: Moonwalkers
item.moonwalkers.unique: Reverses your movement direction, at 120% of your normal speed.
item.moritz_s_gear.description: A patchwork suit of salvaged plates and padded canvas, stitched by someone who never slept.
item.moritz_s_gear.lore: Moritz was a scavenger who built a full suit of armor from resort wreckage. The suit is still here. The rest of the story is somewhere in the snow.
item.moritz_s_gear.name: Moritz's Gear
item.mothers_beating_pendant.description: A pulsing, fist-sized locket of wet flesh and veined gold. It keeps time with your own heart, a beat behind.
item.mothers_beating_pendant.lore: The caves deeper than the caves give up strange things. This one was warm in the dark, and asked to come along.
item.mothers_beating_pendant.name: Mother's Beating Pendant
item.mothers_beating_pendant.unique: +20% max health, +4 life per second, Healing Dome lasts 10 s longer and restores energy.
item.motorboat_modification_blueprints.d: Water-stained blueprints for a stripped motorboat, margins crammed with angry corrections.
item.motorboat_modification_blueprints.l: Whoever drew these wanted to leave the island at any speed. The notes get less sane toward the bottom.
item.mutant_marrow.description: A glistening, lumpy cylinder of marrow that twitches when ignored.
item.mutant_marrow.lore: Useful for crafting, as long as you don't look at it as it pulses.
item.mutant_marrow.name: Mutant Marrow
item.mysterious_robe.description: A deep blue robe woven with threads that flicker like frost under starlight.
item.mysterious_robe.lore: Found folded on a pedestal in a cave no map shows. It is always colder than the room it sits in, and it hums when something magical dies nearby.
item.mysterious_robe.name: Mysterious robe
item.mysterious_robe.unique: Empowers your Cataclysm spell: the vortex turns arcane blue, strikes harder and freezes enemies caught inside.
item.mystery_boots.description: Boots of seamless dark material that don't leave tracks.
item.mystery_boots.lore: Nobody remembers who wore them first. Everyone remembers where they ended up.
item.mystery_boots.name: Mystery Boots
item.mystery_breastplate.description: A smooth, unmarked chest piece of unknown gray alloy.
item.mystery_breastplate.lore: Whatever it is made of, it is not from this island. Neither, the cult says, are its previous owners.
item.mystery_breastplate.name: Mystery Breastplate
item.mystery_gauntlet.description: A seamless dark gauntlet with no joints, yet fully flexible.
item.mystery_gauntlet.lore: It fits every hand, as if the hand were the part being adjusted.
item.mystery_gauntlet.name: Mystery Gauntlet
item.mystery_helmet.description: A seamless helmet of dark gray metal with a faint inner glow.
item.mystery_helmet.lore: It fits like it was made for you. This is the part that bothers people.
item.mystery_helmet.name: Mystery Helmet
item.mystery_leggins.description: Seamless leggings of an unfamiliar gray-green fabric.
item.mystery_leggins.lore: Nobody can say how they're made. They never wrinkle, tear or get wet.
item.mystery_leggins.name: Mystery Leggins
item.mystery_shield.description: A shield of smooth, unmarked metal that reflects nothing.
item.mystery_shield.lore: Found stacked with others in a sealed vault. Nobody wrote down what they were for.
item.mystery_shield.name: Mystery Shield
item.mystery_shoulder_pads.description: Smooth shoulder guards of an unknown gray metal that never shows a scratch.
item.mystery_shoulder_pads.lore: Nobody knows who made them, or why they feel warm when you're being watched.
item.mystery_shoulder_pads.name: Mystery Shoulder Pads
item.mystery_wristguards.description: Seamless, matte wristguards that tighten to fit when worn.
item.mystery_wristguards.lore: Left in a sealed bunker box labeled only with a question mark.
item.mystery_wristguards.name: Mystery Wristguards
item.nail_gloves.description: Rough work gloves with bent nails hammered through the knuckles.
item.nail_gloves.lore: A tribal fashion statement and a practical one. They leave a lasting impression on anyone who sticks around to see it.
item.nail_gloves.name: Nail Gloves
item.napkin_notes_on_fire.description: A greasy napkin covered in scribbled diagrams of flames.
item.napkin_notes_on_fire.lore: Somebody at the resort bar worked out how to make fire do what they wanted. Their drink was never finished.
item.napkin_notes_on_fire.name: Napkin Notes on Fire
item.napkin_notes_on_fire.unique: Firebolt deals 0.3 more times spell damage.
item.nine_iron_of_last_resort.descriptio: A bent steel golf club wrapped in grip tape and electrical tape.
item.nine_iron_of_last_resort.lore: Sold in the pro shop for four hundred dollars. It has since earned that price back, one skull at a time.
item.nine_iron_of_last_resort.name: Nine Iron of Last Resort
item.novice_magic_caster_s_bracers.descr: Cloth-wrapped bracers scratched with beginner's sigils and a few smudged corrections.
item.novice_magic_caster_s_bracers.lore: Someone's first attempt at the old craft, abandoned half-finished. The sigils work, mostly. The smudges are the dangerous part.
item.novice_magic_caster_s_bracers.name: Novice Magic Caster's Bracers
item.novice_magic_caster_s_gloves.descri: Thin cloth gloves with faint sigils inked on the fingertips, a little smudged.
item.novice_magic_caster_s_gloves.lore: The ink runs when it rains, which makes every storm a gamble. Even so, the wearer kept trying.
item.novice_magic_caster_s_gloves.name: Novice Magic Caster's Gloves
item.old_boots.description: Cracked work boots with flapping soles and laces that have given up.
item.old_boots.lore: They have walked farther than you have. Whoever wore them last stopped walking somewhere unpleasant.
item.old_boots.name: Old Boots
item.old_buckler.description: A small, battered buckler with a dented rim and a flaking coat of paint.
item.old_buckler.lore: It is hardly bigger than a plate, and just as breakable. It is also fast, which is half of what blocking means.
item.old_buckler.name: Old Buckler
item.old_scroll.description: A brittle roll of waxed paper covered in cramped, faded handwriting.
item.old_scroll.lore: Pulled from a bunker locker that was otherwise full of rations. Whoever wrote it was scared and very good at spelling.
item.old_scroll.name: Old Scroll
item.ornate_feather.description: A long feather banded in deep blue and gold.
item.ornate_feather.lore: Seen only on birds that live near the highest peaks. This one landed in the snow like a signature.
item.ornate_feather.name: Ornate Feather
item.ornate_feather.unique: Socket it into an empty slot on a piece of gear to add stats to that item.
item.passenger_s_jacket.description: A creased travel jacket with a dead boarding pass still zipped into the pocket.
item.passenger_s_jacket.lore: Its owner was bound for somewhere with a view. The boarding pass lists the window seat, and the window did not hold.
item.passenger_s_jacket.name: Passenger's Jacket
item.peasant_s_scarf.description: A plain wool scarf, patched and re-patched many times.
item.peasant_s_scarf.lore: A sign of someone who kept going despite everything. Comfortable, humble and surprisingly stubborn.
item.peasant_s_scarf.name: Peasant's Scarf
item.pendant_of_perpetual_rebirth.descri: A black glass pendant holding a tiny silver loop that never stops turning.
item.pendant_of_perpetual_rebirth.lore: Its makers died, were revived, and died again, in a cycle that someone kept careful notes about. The notes are missing. The loop is not.
item.pendant_of_perpetual_rebirth.name: Pendant of Perpetual Rebirth
item.pendant_of_perpetual_rebirth.unique: Every time you hit something with a melee or ranged attack, one random spell cooldown is reduced by 1 second.
item.phase_pauldrons.description: Silver pauldrons that shimmer at the edges, as if only half of them are really here.
item.phase_pauldrons.lore: Stamped with serial codes from a lab that no longer exists. When you lift them, the air around your shoulders keeps stepping slightly out of line.
item.phase_pauldrons.name: Phase Pauldrons
item.phase_pauldrons.unique: Blink travels 40 meters farther and strikes every enemy you pass through.
item.phoenix_s_death.description: A greatbow of blackened wood with limbs that glow faintly orange at the tips.
item.phoenix_s_death.lore: The cult burned a bird on this bow for reasons no one remembers. The bow did not forgive the bird, or the fire.
item.phoenix_s_death.name: Phoenix's Death
item.phoenix_s_death.unique: Arrows from this greatbow set enemies on fire.
item.piercer.description: A long needle-like talisman on a cord, sharpened to a point that never dulls.
item.piercer.lore: It finds the gap in anything: armor, hide, or a hasty plan. The old owners swore it chose its own targets and generally agreed with them.
item.piercer.name: Piercer
item.pirate_pants.description: Wide-legged striped pants with a rope belt and a surprising number of hidden pockets.
item.pirate_pants.lore: They belonged to someone who loved treasure more than gravity. The pockets still jingle faintly with coins that are no longer there.
item.pirate_pants.name: Pirate Pants
item.plaid_trousers_of_quiet_rage.descri: Loud plaid golf trousers, torn at the knee and stained in colors the pattern never intended.
item.plaid_trousers_of_quiet_rage.lore: Nobody who wore these has ever shot under par, but they win the arguments.
item.plaid_trousers_of_quiet_rage.name: Plaid Trousers of Quiet Rage
item.plate_armour.description: A dented steel breastplate, hammered flat enough to wear and thick enough to trust.
item.plate_armour.lore: Someone at the resort called it a collector's piece. In practice it is a portable wall, and it clangs loudly enough to make stealth a rumor.
item.plate_armour.name: Plate armour
item.plate_leggins.description: Articulated steel leg plates, strapped over padded cloth and clanking at every step.
item.plate_leggins.lore: Silent movement is for people who wear hide. You wear steel, and you have your reasons.
item.plate_leggins.name: Plate Leggins
item.pot_lid_shield.description: A dented pot lid with a leather strap bolted to the back.
item.pot_lid_shield.lore: It once covered a stew. Now it covers you. Neither of you smells any better.
item.pot_lid_shield.name: Pot Lid Shield
item.potato_sack.description: A burlap sack with a drawstring top, stuffed with arrows instead of tubers.
item.potato_sack.lore: Nobody ever claimed it was fancy. It holds arrows, and arrows are what matter when the cannibals get close.
item.potato_sack.name: Potato Sack
item.precise_adjustments.description: A quiver whose straps are lined with tiny brass dials and tick marks.
item.precise_adjustments.lore: Someone in the buried complex tuned this to the millimeter. They also tuned a whole shelf of tools that shoot back.
item.precise_adjustments.name: Precise Adjustments
item.precise_adjustments.unique: Focus's attack speed buff lasts 16 seconds longer.
item.printed_kevlar_chaps.description: Cut-resistant chaps extruded from a bunker printer in one gray piece.
item.printed_kevlar_chaps.lore: Rated to stop knives, claws and mild disappointment. Not rated for teeth.
item.printed_kevlar_chaps.name: Printed Kevlar Chaps
item.printed_polymer_chassis.description: A chest plate printed in one piece, still faintly warm and smelling of hot plastic.
item.printed_polymer_chassis.lore: Somebody queued up a thousand of these and then stopped answering the printer. The print log ends mid-sentence.
item.printed_polymer_chassis.name: Printed Polymer Chassis
item.printed_sole_runners.description: Lightweight boots grown layer by layer in a bunker printer, with tread patterns like a circuit board.
item.printed_sole_runners.lore: The soles were printed with the previous owner's footprints. You will leave their tracks, whoever you are.
item.printed_sole_runners.name: Printed Sole Runners
item.printer_filament_spool.description: A heavy spool of high-grade gray bunker filament.
item.printer_filament_spool.lore: Eight kilometers of polymer, enough to print a suit of armor or a very ambitious coffin.
item.printer_filament_spool.name: Printer Filament Spool
item.punny_s_reflective_ring.description: A silver ring with a polished face that shows your reflection, fractured into pieces.
item.punny_s_reflective_ring.lore: It once belonged to a joker who laughed at everything, even the end. The ring still giggles in the quiet.
item.punny_s_reflective_ring.name: Echoing Ring
item.punny_s_reflective_ring.unique: Magic Arrow fires in volleys of 3 extra arrows per cast. Multiple copies stack.
item.purgatory.description: A scorched iron ring etched with tiny flames and an ash-gray stone.
item.purgatory.lore: The cult believed suffering paid for power. This ring keeps the ledger and sends the bill straight to you.
item.purgatory.name: Purgatory
item.purgatory.unique: Purge raises all your damage as your life drops, by up to 300%.
item.pyromancy_mask.description: A cracked clay mask blackened with soot, its mouth stained orange.
item.pyromancy_mask.lore: The cult's fire priests wore these to stare into the flames without looking away. Some never did.
item.pyromancy_mask.name: Pyromancy Mask
item.quiver_of_bottled_lightning.descrip: A glass-fronted quiver with arrows that crackle faintly and make your hair stand up.
item.quiver_of_bottled_lightning.lore: Packed by someone who understood the problem with lightning, which is that you can't carry it. They carried it.
item.quiver_of_bottled_lightning.name: Quiver of Bottled Lightning
item.quiver_of_bottled_lightning.unique: +25% pierce chance, Multishot fires 2 more arrows, with damage penalty 10% worse.
item.rabbit_ears_hairband.description: A plain hairband topped with two floppy, mud-stained rabbit ears.
