item.rabbit_ears_hairband.lore: Found in a resort room with a very strange guest list. The ears have survived things they shouldn't have.
item.rabbit_ears_hairband.name: Rabbit Ears Hairband
item.rabbit_skin_quiver.description: A soft quiver of rabbit fur, stitched tight and lined with grass for quiet storage.
item.rabbit_skin_quiver.lore: A lucky foot hangs from the strap, which is a funny thing to say about the rabbit.
item.rabbit_skin_quiver.name: Rabbit Skin Quiver
item.rage.description: A huge, notched greatsword that seems to hum before it swings.
item.rage.lore: A tribal leader dragged this through the snow for years. When he finally swung it, the people behind him ran.
item.rage.name: Rage
item.ranger_s_bracers.description: Leather bracers with a stitched bow guard and bits of bark tucked in the seams.
item.ranger_s_bracers.lore: Made by someone who spent months learning the woods, then months learning how to hide in them. Neither lesson helped for long.
item.ranger_s_bracers.name: Ranger's Bracers
item.ranger_s_gloves.description: Supple leather gloves with the fingertips cut away for a clean grip on the string.
item.ranger_s_gloves.lore: Worn thin at the thumb and forefinger from thousands of arrows. The previous owner had very good habits.
item.ranger_s_gloves.name: Ranger's Gloves
item.rebar_greatsword.description: A rebar rod flattened, ground and wrapped in duct tape.
item.rebar_greatsword.lore: The blade doesn't cut so much as hammer through the problem. The problem rarely objects twice.
item.rebar_greatsword.name: Rebar Greatsword
item.red_skirt.description: A faded red skirt with a torn hem, stiff with mud and old stains.
item.red_skirt.lore: Found in the resort wardrobe, still pressed. It has seen the island and it has opinions.
item.red_skirt.name: Red Skirt
item.reef_shark.description: A small, hooked shark tooth with a serrated edge.
item.reef_shark.lore: Washed up on the shore with a lot of broken shells. The shark that owned it is presumably still angry.
item.reef_shark.name: Reef Shark
item.reef_shark.unique: Socket it into an empty slot on a piece of gear to add stats to that item.
item.relic_hammer.description: A heavy iron hammer with a cracked head and a haft wrapped in old rope.
item.relic_hammer.lore: Pulled from a ruin that was ancient before the resort was built. It feels less like a tool and more like a decision about to be made.
item.relic_hammer.name: Relic Hammer
item.relic_hammer.unique: Hits slow the enemy they strike.
item.rendered_fat_hauberk.description: A cuirass layered with hardened fat from some enormous, long-dead hulk.
item.rendered_fat_hauberk.lore: It wobbles when you walk and bounces blades like wet clay. The smell is also a weapon.
item.rendered_fat_hauberk.name: Rendered-Fat Hauberk
item.revving_fury.description: A chainsaw lashed to a long pole, with a fraying pull cord.
item.revving_fury.lore: Its engine screams at the same pitch as the things it hunts. The two share the same language.
item.revving_fury.name: Revving Fury
item.revving_fury.unique: +35% attack speed, but attacks cost 40% more stamina.
item.ring_of_fortune.description: A heavy gold band set with a clouded, faintly glowing stone.
item.ring_of_fortune.lore: Found on a finger in a bunker freezer, still warm. Everyone who wore it swore the dice always came up their way, right up to the day they didn't.
item.ring_of_fortune.name: Ring of Fortune
item.ring_of_seven_bites.description: A tarnished ring pitted with the tiny tooth marks of seven different jaws.
item.ring_of_seven_bites.lore: Each bite was a different attempt to take it back. Each owner died with a different smile.
item.ring_of_seven_bites.name: Ring of Seven Bites
item.ring_of_seven_bites.unique: +12% damage and +20% chance to bleed on hit, but you take 10% more damage.
item.riot_door_shield.description: A slab of reinforced bunker door with a viewport slit and one bent hinge.
item.riot_door_shield.lore: Four people couldn't shut this door against what was behind it. It turns out one person can hold it open indefinitely.
item.riot_door_shield.name: Riot Door Shield
item.rippers_cleaver.description: A butcher's cleaver rebuilt with a serrated spine for tearing, not cutting.
item.rippers_cleaver.lore: Made for flesh that grows back wrong. The blade has learned which kind of meat to hate.
item.rippers_cleaver.name: Ripper's Cleaver
item.rough_hide_leggins.description: Heavy leggings of rough animal hide, stiff with salt and stitched with sinew.
item.rough_hide_leggins.lore: Wearing them feels like walking in someone else's skin, because you are. They are warm, they smell terrible and they have never once gotten stuck on a branch.
item.rough_hide_leggins.name: Rough Hide Leggins
item.round_shield.description: A round wooden shield with an iron boss and a strap worn smooth by many arms.
item.round_shield.lore: The first thing a recruit is handed and the last thing a veteran lets go. It does a lot for what it costs.
item.round_shield.name: Round Shield
item.rusty_javelin.description: A short spear with a pitted iron head and a cracked wooden shaft.
item.rusty_javelin.lore: Pulled from a mutant's back in a snowfield. It had been there long enough for the skin to grow over the wound.
item.rusty_javelin.name: Rusty Javelin
item.rusty_longsword.description: A pitted longsword with a crusted edge and a grip wrapped in grimy leather.
item.rusty_longsword.lore: It sat in a snowbank for a winter or three. Tetanus is a free enchantment and the edge still bites.
item.rusty_longsword.name: Rusty Longsword
item.rusty_polearm.description: A pole with a rust-brown spearhead tied on with wire and fishing line.
item.rusty_polearm.lore: Not much of a weapon, but it keeps things at arm's length plus a bit. In the woods, that is a lot.
item.rusty_polearm.name: Rusty Polearm
item.sacrificial_kris.description: A wavy-bladed ritual dagger with a handle wrapped in cult banner cloth.
item.sacrificial_kris.lore: Cut once for the offering, twice for the blessing, three times for whoever disagreed.
item.sacrificial_kris.name: Sacrificial Kris
item.sacrificial_kris.unique: +12% crit chance and +80% crit damage, but -10% maximum health.
item.sage_s_robes.description: Long cloth robes with ink-stained cuffs and a pocket stuffed with unfinished notes.
item.sage_s_robes.lore: Their owner never stopped taking notes, even in the snow, even in the dark, even as the caves came for him. The notes are still being added to.
item.sage_s_robes.name: Sage's Robes
item.scarf.description: A thick woolen scarf, hand-knit in uneven stripes and long enough to be dangerous.
item.scarf.lore: Someone made this with love and a rough sense of gauge. It keeps your neck warm, and the people who want your neck at bay.
item.scarf.name: Scarf
item.scroll_of_recovery.description: A small scroll sealed with candle wax and a smear of something that smells like pine sap.
item.scroll_of_recovery.lore: Kelvin carried one and could not read it. Still, he guarded it like it was the last bandage on the island.
item.scroll_of_recovery.name: Scroll of Recovery
item.scroll_of_the_frozen_choir.descript: A frost-brittle scroll that sings faintly when held near an open window.
item.scroll_of_the_frozen_choir.lore: Seven voices wrote it. Six of them could not hold the note, and the seventh is still holding it.
item.scroll_of_the_frozen_choir.name: Scroll of the Frozen Choir
item.scroll_of_the_frozen_choir.unique: Snow Storm gains 5 max charge, and Snap Freeze deals 1.5 more times spell damage.
item.severer.description: A long, ruthless axe with a wide, hooked edge that bites deep.
item.severer.lore: The name was scratched into the handle by someone proud of what it did. Leave it on a stump overnight and the stump will be in two pieces.
item.severer.name: Severer
item.sharpshooter_s_axe.description: A fine-balanced axe with a scope sight bolted to the blade.
item.sharpshooter_s_axe.lore: She never missed, so the axe never needed to be heavy. It still can't be put down.
item.sharpshooter_s_axe.name: Sharpshooter's Axe
item.sharpshooter_s_axe.unique: Pistol damage is multiplied by 6 and pistol critical hit chance increases by 50%.
item.shield.description: A plain round shield of nailed oak boards, banded with iron.
item.shield.lore: Nothing fancy, and nothing about it is meant to be. It gets one job and does it faithfully until the day it doesn't.
item.shield.name: Shield
item.shield_blade.description: A wide greatsword with a hand-guard shaped like a tower shield.
item.shield_blade.lore: Forged by someone who couldn't decide between offense and defense, and so decided to need both.
item.shield_blade.name: Shield Blade
item.shield_of_the_first_survivor.descri: A battered riot shield with scorched handprints along the grip, none of them yours.
item.shield_of_the_first_survivor.lore: Rumor has it a survivor held this against the first wave and then refused to put it down. Their hands are still on it.
item.shield_of_the_first_survivor.name: Shield of the First Survivor
item.shield_of_the_first_survivor.unique: You can parry anything, parry has a chance to trigger when you are hit, and its radius is 3 m larger.
item.shiny_moonstone.description: A polished white gem that gleams like a small captured moon.
item.shiny_moonstone.lore: It reflects no firelight, only its own. Some say it listens when you whisper.
item.shiny_moonstone.name: Shiny Moonstone
item.shiny_moonstone.unique: Socket it into an empty slot on a piece of gear to add stats to that item.
item.shiny_sapphire.description: A polished, deep blue gem that throws sparkles across the walls.
item.shiny_sapphire.lore: Cut to a rough shape by a skilled hand. It catches firelight and throws it back brighter.
item.shiny_sapphire.name: Shiny Sapphire
item.shiny_sapphire.unique: Socket it into an empty slot on a piece of gear to add stats to that item.
item.shoulder_guards.description: Hardened shoulder guards of boiled leather and thin iron, laced to a stiff harness.
item.shoulder_guards.lore: Built for people who expect to be hit and prefer it happen somewhere that matters less.
item.shoulder_guards.name: Shoulder Guards
item.sigil_ring_of_the_nameless_flock.de: A black iron ring stamped with an eye inside an eye inside an eye.
item.sigil_ring_of_the_nameless_flock.lo: Handed out at the third ceremony. Nobody remembers the first two, which is considered part of the initiation.
item.sigil_ring_of_the_nameless_flock.na: Sigil Ring of the Nameless Flock
item.silver_armor.description: Gleaming silver-gray armor engraved with swirling lines.
item.silver_armor.lore: Looks like treasure and it is. The cult buried a dozen sets of this and dug up eleven.
item.silver_armor.name: Silver Armor
item.silver_locket_of_agility.descriptio: A silver locket shaped like a swallow in mid-flight, hung on a thin chain.
item.silver_locket_of_agility.lore: Swallows leave before the cold comes. Anyone who wears this is invited to do the same, and a few have taken the hint.
item.silver_locket_of_agility.name: Silver Locket of Agility
item.silver_locket_of_intelligence.descr: A silver locket with a small blue crystal sealed behind a glass lid.
item.silver_locket_of_intelligence.lore: The crystal hums when someone nearby is thinking something dangerous. It hums a lot on this island.
item.silver_locket_of_intelligence.name: Silver Locket of Intelligence
item.silver_locket_of_strength.descripti: A silver locket stamped with a lion, dented from years of knocks.
item.silver_locket_of_strength.lore: Carried into more brawls than it can count. It has never opened, and that is a mercy.
item.silver_locket_of_strength.name: Silver Locket of Strength
item.silver_locket_of_vitality.descripti: A silver locket on a braided cord, warm to the touch and faintly damp.
item.silver_locket_of_vitality.lore: Said to hold a drop of spring water from a place that does not freeze. It keeps its wearer a little bit more alive than strictly necessary.
item.silver_locket_of_vitality.name: Silver Locket of Vitality
item.silver_ring_of_agility.description: A thin silver ring inscribed with tiny feathers that seem to ruffle in the wind.
item.silver_ring_of_agility.lore: Light, quick, and impossible to hear coming. Wearers describe it as the opposite of a leash.
item.silver_ring_of_agility.name: Silver Ring of Agility
item.silver_ring_of_intelligence.descrip: A silver ring set with a pale moonstone that clouds when spells are near.
item.silver_ring_of_intelligence.lore: Scholars never agree on where it came from. They agree on how it feels when a spell goes right: tidy, clear and faintly smug.
item.silver_ring_of_intelligence.name: Silver Ring of Intelligence
item.silver_ring_of_strength.description: A polished silver ring cut with the shape of a roaring head.
item.silver_ring_of_strength.lore: Silver is supposed to ward off things that go bump. Here it mostly carries the bump, forward, with force.
item.silver_ring_of_strength.name: Silver Ring of Strength
item.silver_ring_of_vitality.description: A silver band engraved with a ring of leaves that never quite stop growing.
item.silver_ring_of_vitality.lore: It warms against the skin and keeps its owner stubbornly upright. A cut closes faster under it, though it never says thank you.
item.silver_ring_of_vitality.name: Silver Ring of Vitality
item.sled_runner_boots.description: Boots fitted with bolt-on steel runners for skating over packed snow.
item.sled_runner_boots.lore: Invented after the third failed sled. The first two are still somewhere down the mountain.
item.sled_runner_boots.name: Sled Runner Boots
item.small_tribal_necklace.description: A string of bone beads and a single chipped tooth.
item.small_tribal_necklace.lore: Given to boys who survived their first hunt. The tooth is the proof, and it was the other guy's.
item.small_tribal_necklace.name: Small Tribal Necklace
item.small_tribal_necklace.unique: Raises your maximum Frenzy stacks by 2.
item.smasher.description: A huge hammer with a head cast from a car's engine block.
item.smasher.lore: Forged in the resort's ruined garage by someone with a grudge and a welding torch. It does one thing.
item.smasher.name: Smasher
item.smokey_s_sacred_quiver.description: A weathered quiver burned black at the rim and carved with sooty prayer marks.
item.smokey_s_sacred_quiver.lore: Smokey carried it through three fires and an argument with a bear. The smell never quite left the leather, and neither did the faith.
item.smokey_s_sacred_quiver.name: Smokey's Sacred Quiver
item.smokey_s_sacred_quiver.unique: Crossbows fire 2.5 times as fast and deal 400% more damage.
item.socket_drill.description: A small hand drill with a diamond-tipped bit and a battered brass crank.
item.socket_drill.lore: Some bunker engineer built it to open sealed panels. It also opens gear, and occasionally fingers.
item.socket_drill.name: Socket Drill
item.socket_drill.unique: Adds one socket to an item, unless the item already has the maximum.
item.soft_feather.description: A fluffy, pale feather that stays warm in your palm.
item.soft_feather.lore: Gathered from a nest on a cold ledge. The chicks were gone, and nobody asked where.
item.soft_feather.name: Soft Feather
item.soft_feather.unique: Socket it into an empty slot on a piece of gear to add stats to that item.
item.soulstring.description: A pale greatbow strung with something thin, red and flexible that is definitely not cord.
item.soulstring.lore: It drinks a little of each shot from whoever draws it. Everyone who has held it agrees it is not a metaphor.
item.soulstring.name: Soulstring
item.soulstring.unique: Blood Infused Arrow deals bonus damage for every point of life it consumes.
item.spell_scroll.description: A rolled parchment sealed with dark wax and covered in cramped, glowing script.
item.spell_scroll.lore: Reading it aloud is optional. The scroll reads you either way, and the cost is a headache and a little more fate.
item.spell_scroll.name: Spell Scroll
item.spellbound_quiver.description: A quiver stitched with glowing thread, humming faintly as arrows slide in and out.
item.spellbound_quiver.lore: Every arrow comes out of it slightly more than it went in. Those who hold it too long begin to hear the arrows whisper.
item.spellbound_quiver.name: Spellbound Quiver
item.spiked_cleats.description: Waterproof golf shoes with replacement spikes screwed in by someone who clearly meant it.
item.spiked_cleats.lore: The spikes are not standard issue. Neither are the stains on them.
item.spiked_cleats.name: Spiked Cleats
item.spiked_ring.description: A chunky iron ring with bristling spikes, designed to leave a lasting impression.
item.spiked_ring.lore: Handshakes with this ring were considered rude. Punches with it were considered final.
item.spiked_ring.name: Spiked ring
item.star_robe.description: A midnight-blue robe stitched with tiny pale points of light.
item.star_robe.lore: The cult wore these when the stars were said to be wrong. By the look of the sky above the peak, they were right.
item.star_robe.name: Star Robe
item.steel_boots.description: Fitted steel boots with articulated ankles and a spiked heel.
item.steel_boots.lore: The spikes are decorative, the cult says. Their victims disagree.
item.steel_boots.name: Steel Boots
item.steel_breastplate.description: A polished steel breastplate with a ridged center line.
item.steel_breastplate.lore: Forged for a resort security chief. He never got to find out what it could do.
item.steel_breastplate.name: Steel Breastplate
item.steel_gauntlet.description: A well-jointed steel gauntlet with a studded knuckle guard.
item.steel_gauntlet.lore: A good craftsman made it. A better one used it on mutants.
item.steel_gauntlet.name: Steel Gauntlet
item.steel_helmet.description: A smooth steel helm with a full face guard and narrow eye slits.
item.steel_helmet.lore: Made for a cultist captain who preferred not to be recognized. It works.
item.steel_helmet.name: Steel Helmet
item.steel_ring_of_agility.description: A narrow steel ring, perfectly round and perfectly light.
item.steel_ring_of_agility.lore: Thieves swear it improves their luck, and soldiers swear it improves their aim. The ring has never said which of them is lying.
item.steel_ring_of_agility.name: Steel Ring of Agility
item.steel_ring_of_intelligence.descript: A steel ring etched with fine geometric lines that glow faintly in the dark.
item.steel_ring_of_intelligence.lore: Plain metal, clever work. It will not make you smart, but it does make your mistakes more interesting.
item.steel_ring_of_intelligence.name: Steel Ring of Intelligence
item.steel_ring_of_strength.description: A heavy steel ring with a flat face, forged to take a punch and give one back.
item.steel_ring_of_strength.lore: Unromantic and honest. The kind of ring a blacksmith makes to say that he means it.
item.steel_ring_of_strength.name: Steel Ring of Strength
item.steel_ring_of_vitality.description: A dull steel ring with a green stone set at the center.
item.steel_ring_of_vitality.lore: It does not heal anyone. It simply reminds your body that quitting is a choice, and you did not choose it.
item.steel_ring_of_vitality.name: Steel Ring of Vitality
item.steel_shoulder_pads.description: Polished steel shoulder guards with a ridge along the top.
item.steel_shoulder_pads.lore: Cult smiths made them lighter than they look. They still ring like a bell when hit.
item.steel_shoulder_pads.name: Steel Shoulder Pads
item.steel_tasset.description: Hinged steel plates hanging from a sturdy belt.
item.steel_tasset.lore: Good armor, bad for sitting. Fortunately sitting is rare on this island.
item.steel_tasset.name: Steel Tasset
item.steel_tower_shield.description: A tall, rectangular steel shield with a narrow viewing slit.
item.steel_tower_shield.lore: The cult's guards hid behind these at the gates. Behind them, they felt invincible.
item.steel_tower_shield.name: Steel Tower Shield
item.steel_wristguard.description: A well-made steel wristguard with a fitted forearm plate.
item.steel_wristguard.lore: Smiths took pride in these. Mutants took pride in biting them.
item.steel_wristguard.name: Steel Wristguard
item.stomach_acid.description: A glass jar of cloudy yellow fluid that fizzes against the lid.
item.stomach_acid.lore: Harvested from something large and unfortunate. It dissolves the bad parts of whatever you soak in it.
item.stomach_acid.name: Stomach Acid
item.stomach_acid.unique: Removes every stat with a negative value from an item.
item.stone_pauldrons.description: Rough stone slabs lashed to a leather yoke.
item.stone_pauldrons.lore: The tribes' stone-carvers made these first, for fights too sudden to bother with iron.
item.stone_pauldrons.name: Stone Pauldrons
item.stone_shield.description: A flat slab of dressed stone with leather straps on the back.
item.stone_shield.lore: Heavier than it should be. The tribes call it a wall you can carry.
item.stone_shield.name: Stone Shield
item.straw_hat.description: A wide woven hat, sun-bleached and fraying at the brim.
item.straw_hat.lore: Left behind at the resort's pool bar. It survived everything the island threw at it, unlike its owner.
item.straw_hat.name: Straw Hat
item.sturdy_leather_boots.description: Thick-soled leather boots stitched twice over and oiled against the cold.
item.sturdy_leather_boots.lore: A hunter's pair, resoled so often the original leather is a rumor. Good traction on ice, and on things that used to be people.
item.sturdy_leather_boots.name: Sturdy Leather Boots
item.sword_devil_s_scarf.description: A crimson scarf embroidered with tiny crossed swords and a horned grin.
item.sword_devil_s_scarf.lore: Said to have belonged to a duelist who never lost. Now it lies on the ground, and he lies elsewhere.
item.sword_devil_s_scarf.name: Sword Devil's Scarf
item.swordsman_s_bracers.description: Thick forearm bracers of hammered scrap, scarred from parries and dents.
item.swordsman_s_bracers.lore: Every notch tells a story of a close call. The newest one is still shiny.
item.swordsman_s_bracers.name: Swordsman's Bracers
item.swordsman_s_gloves.description: Stiff leather gloves reinforced with metal plates over the knuckles.
item.swordsman_s_gloves.lore: Meant for a duelist who thought the island would be fair. It was fair, in the way a storm is fair.
item.swordsman_s_gloves.name: Swordsman's Gloves
item.the_executioner.description: A long sword with a heavy, squared-off tip and a handle wrapped in black cloth.
item.the_executioner.lore: The tribe's leaders use these for ceremonies. There is only ever one ceremony.
item.the_executioner.name: The Executioner
item.the_great_iron_horn.description: A massive iron horn engraved with battle scenes, its mouthpiece worn smooth by countless lips.
item.the_great_iron_horn.lore: When it sounds, the cannibals go quiet and the mutants answer. Every echo it makes is a roll call of the people who didn't live to hear it again.
item.the_great_iron_horn.name: The Great Iron Horn
item.the_great_iron_horn.unique: When you use Warcry, you and your allies gain armor equal to 10% of your armor and also gain bonus damage resistance.
item.the_leech.description: A greatsword with a dark, ribbed blade that seems to glisten even when it is dry.
item.the_leech.lore: Every wound it makes drinks a little of the victim's strength and hands it to the wielder. Its previous owners are remembered as lucky, right up to the end.
item.the_leech.name: The Leech
item.the_one_ring_to_rule_them_all.descr: A plain gold band that is heavier than any ring has a right to be.
item.the_one_ring_to_rule_them_all.lore: Every power on the island has wanted it at some point. It wants a bearer that can keep pace with its ambitions, and it is not picky about the cost.
item.the_one_ring_to_rule_them_all.name: The One Ring To Rule Them All
item.the_one_ring_to_rule_them_all.uniqu: Wearing it draws the hungry attention of an unknown entity that begins to hunt you.
item.the_seventh_page.description: A single sheet of unnatural paper that always looks like it is yours to read.
item.the_seventh_page.lore: The first six pages were burned. This one burned the reader. It is still looking for a new one.
item.the_seventh_page.name: The Seventh Page
item.the_seventh_page.unique: Cataclysm turns arcane, deals 10 more times spell damage and lasts 4 s longer, but all cooldowns are 25% longer.
A scroll bound in singed cloth, with a single point of bright ink at its center.
A lone engineer wrote this in the dark of the complex, after the lights died. The last line says only: do not look away.
The Spark of Light in The Darkness
If a black hole hits 5 or more enemies in its lifetime, it releases a ball lightning when it ends.
item.thick_rubber_glove.description: A heavy yellow rubber glove, the kind used to scrub things that should stay scrubbed.
item.thick_rubber_glove.lore: Found beside a drain in the ruined resort. Nobody knows what it was cleaning, and you have chosen not to ask the drain.
item.thick_rubber_glove.name: Thick Rubber Glove
item.thornmail.description: Heavy chest armor covered in jagged iron barbs, wired on by hand.
item.thornmail.lore: Made by a survivor who decided hugging distance was the best strategy. Hugs last a short time and end badly.
item.thornmail.name: Thornmail
item.threads.description: Ragged boots wrapped in strips of colored cloth over thick soles.
item.threads.lore: Nothing about them is neat. Somehow nothing about them is wrong either.
item.threads.name: Threads
item.tiara.description: A thin silver tiara with a crack down one stone, still sparkling in bad light.
item.tiara.lore: Left behind in the ruined resort, probably by someone who was sure the rescue boat was coming. The sparkle remains optimistic.
item.tiara.name: Tiara
item.tiara.unique: It does nothing but shine. Looking good is its own reward.
item.tiger_shark_tooth.description: A broad, curved tooth with fine serrations along both edges.
item.tiger_shark_tooth.lore: Pulled from a wreck in the shallows. The wreck had been picked clean by whatever lives there.
item.tiger_shark_tooth.name: Tiger Shark Tooth
item.tiger_shark_tooth.unique: Socket it into an empty slot on a piece of gear to add stats to that item.
item.titanium_gauntlet.description: A light, pale-gray gauntlet that feels like wearing nothing.
item.titanium_gauntlet.lore: From the bunker armory. The label said 'prototype' and the hand inside was missing.
item.titanium_gauntlet.name: Titanium Gauntlet
item.titanium_leggins.description: Plated leg armor of dull gray titanium, light for its strength and a bit cold.
item.titanium_leggins.lore: Salvaged from the buried complex where it was made for someone who expected to walk through fire. Nobody ever tested that.
item.titanium_leggins.name: Titanium Leggins
item.titanium_ore.description: A silvery, light chunk of ore that resists the cold.
item.titanium_ore.lore: Strong, light and stubborn. Digging it out is a miserable job, which is why it is worth the trouble.
item.titanium_ore.name: Titanium Ore
item.titanium_ore.unique: Socket it into an empty slot on a piece of gear to add stats to that item.
item.torso_of_strength.description: A broad breastplate molded to the shape of an imposing chest.
item.torso_of_strength.lore: Whoever wore it must have been strong, or at least believed they were. Either way, it works.
item.torso_of_strength.name: Torso of Strength
item.tower_shield.description: A tall slab of reinforced steel with a viewing slit and a pair of heavy grips.
item.tower_shield.lore: A mobile fortress with a handle. Standing behind it is boring, and boring is how you get old on this island.
item.tower_shield.name: Tower Shield
item.toxic_ring.description: A green-stained ring set with a vial of something that bubbles when you flinch.
item.toxic_ring.lore: The wearer is expected to be careful. The wearer before you was not, and the stain on the finger bone proves the point.
item.toxic_ring.name: Toxic Ring
item.toxic_ring.unique: Gives you a chance on hit to make enemies bleed.
item.traders_puffer_jacket.description: A bright orange puffer jacket, patched with tape and stuffed with questionable feathers.
item.traders_puffer_jacket.lore: Warm enough for the mountain, loud enough to bring every predator within a mile.
item.traders_puffer_jacket.name: Trader's Puffer Jacket
item.travel_band.description: A narrow silver ring etched with the outline of a staircase.
item.travel_band.lore: Made for people who needed to be somewhere else, right now. It never says where.
item.travel_band.name: Travel Band
item.tribal_glove.description: A hide glove daubed with ochre paint and sewn with bone beads along the knuckles.
item.tribal_glove.lore: Painted warriors wear these to the hunt. The pattern is a boast, a prayer and a warning, and you only need to read the last one.
item.tribal_glove.name: Tribal Glove
item.tribal_necklace.description: Knotted sinew strung with carved bone and painted wood beads.
item.tribal_necklace.lore: Each bead is a kill, and each knot is a promise to the next one.
item.tribal_necklace.name: Tribal Necklace
item.tribal_necklace.unique: Raises your maximum Frenzy stacks by 3.
item.tribe_leader_glove.description: A thick war glove banded with polished bone and lined with matted fur.
item.tribe_leader_glove.lore: A tribal leader's grip, passed hand to hand through a long line of bloody successions. The previous owner's fingerprints are still in the leather.
item.tribe_leader_glove.name: Tribe Leader Glove
item.tricksters_scarf.description: A long red scarf with glittering threads that catch no light.
item.tricksters_scarf.lore: It takes the shape of whatever neck it is on. It is not very loyal to anyone.
item.tricksters_scarf.name: Tricksters Scarf
item.tungsten_ore.description: A dense, dark chunk of ore as heavy as a small anvil.
item.tungsten_ore.lore: The hardest thing on the island, mined from deep below the complex. Whatever is down there dug it first.
item.tungsten_ore.name: Tungsten Ore
item.tungsten_ore.unique: Socket it into an empty slot on a piece of gear to add stats to that item.
item.twin_skull_pauldrons.description: Two bleached skulls, hollowed and lashed to a leather yoke with sinew.
item.twin_skull_pauldrons.lore: They were a twin set once, which made them worth hunting. The pair now wins every staring contest.
item.twin_skull_pauldrons.name: Twin-Skull Pauldrons
item.uncut_moonstone.description: A cloudy, milk-white stone with a soft inner shimmer.
item.uncut_moonstone.lore: Found in a stream bed, glowing faintly at night. Survivors put them in pockets for luck and forget about them.
item.uncut_moonstone.name: Uncut Moonstone
item.uncut_moonstone.unique: Socket it into an empty slot on a piece of gear to add stats to that item.
item.uncut_sapphire.description: A rough blue stone with chalky edges and one clean face.
item.uncut_sapphire.lore: Dug out of a cave wall by hungry hands that had no idea what it was worth. The island does not trade in coin.
item.uncut_sapphire.name: Uncut Sapphire
item.uncut_sapphire.unique: Socket it into an empty slot on a piece of gear to add stats to that item.
item.undying_promise.description: Black leggings sewn with a thin red thread that seems to move on its own.
item.undying_promise.lore: Someone swore never to die while a debt was owed. Death took the debt seriously.
item.undying_promise.name: Undying Promise
item.undying_promise.unique: Once every 60 seconds, survive a lethal hit.
item.unnamed.description: Frayed dark leggings stitched with jagged crimson lines.
item.unnamed.lore: Cut from the pants of someone who never stopped moving. Wear them and you won't either.
item.unnamed.name: Fury's Hamstrings
item.unnamed.unique: While Frenzy is active, +5% critical hit chance and +3% attack speed.
item.unnamed_2.description: A huge greatsword with a blade pitted by rage and rimmed in dried blood.
item.unnamed_2.lore: Berserkers draw it as a last resort, and it never fails. It has simply never stopped.
item.unnamed_2.name: Berserker's Reckoning
item.unnamed_3.description: A broad greatsword with a chipped edge and a bloodstained grip.
item.unnamed_3.lore: Its last owner flew into a rage and never calmed down. The sword inherited it.
item.unnamed_3.name: Rage Cleaver
item.unnamed_4.description: A pendant of blackened iron on a rope of braided hair.
item.unnamed_4.lore: Warm against the chest and slightly wrong. It wants you to move faster.
item.unnamed_4.name: Redmist Pendant
item.unnamed_4.unique: While Berserk, +10% attack speed and +10% movement speed.
item.unnamed_5.description: A pulsing red amulet shaped like a heart with a spike through it.
item.unnamed_5.lore: Made from a rampaging mutant's heart, or so its seller said. It still beats during fights.
item.unnamed_5.name: Heart of the Rampage
item.unnamed_5.unique: Melee and ranged damage doubled, and Berserk grants +15% attack speed and +30% movement speed.
item.unnamed_6.description: A pale bracer engraved with a protective dome and etched healing sigils.
item.unnamed_6.lore: Worn by a bunker medic who stood in the open and told everyone else to get behind her.
item.unnamed_6.name: Sanctuary Cuff
item.unnamed_6.unique: Healing Dome cooldown rate +100% and its spell cost reduced by 40%.
item.upgraded_armor_hardening_mixture.de: A canister of silver-flecked paste that hardens as you watch.
item.upgraded_armor_hardening_mixture.lo: A bunker chemist's improved recipe. It makes gear shrug off blows, and made the chemist's glove shrug off his hand.
item.upgraded_armor_hardening_mixture.un: Adds the Damage Reduction stat to a piece of equipment that doesn't have one.
item.upgraded_chaos_water.description: A swirling flask of black water streaked with every color at once.
item.upgraded_chaos_water.lore: A cult alchemist distilled it from the first spring and an unwise amount of ambition. Nothing it touches stays itself.
item.upgraded_chaos_water.name: Upgraded Chaos Water
item.upgraded_chaos_water.unique: Rerolls every stat on an item of any rarity.
item.vampire_ring.description: A black ring set with a ruby that slowly swells and shrinks.
item.vampire_ring.lore: The stone is never empty and never full. The tribes bury the hands of those who wear it.
item.vampire_ring.name: Vampire Ring
item.vampire_ring.unique: Gain 10 stamina on each melee or ranged hit, doubled on critical hits.
item.vampiric_band.description: A narrow ring of dull silver with a tiny red stone like a drop of blood.
item.vampiric_band.lore: It drinks a little with every blow and gives a little back. A fair deal, until you check what it takes.
item.vampiric_band.name: Vampiric Band
item.vampiric_band.unique: Gain 1 stamina on each melee or ranged hit, doubled on critical hits.
item.vanadium_ore.description: A hard, bluish chunk of ore with a metallic sheen.
item.vanadium_ore.lore: Used in the complex to make tools that outlast their owners. Most of those owners did not last long.
item.vanadium_ore.name: Vanadium Ore
item.vanadium_ore.unique: Socket it into an empty slot on a piece of gear to add stats to that item.
item.vestment_of_the_quiet_choir.descrip: Ash-gray ceremonial robes lined with stitched prayer slips.
item.vestment_of_the_quiet_choir.lore: The slips are all the same sentence, written thousands of times: 'Please let it be quiet now.'
item.vestment_of_the_quiet_choir.name: Vestment of the Quiet Choir
item.virginia_heart_pendant.description: A dried, shriveled heart on a leather cord, hardened to the consistency of a stone.
item.virginia_heart_pendant.lore: Taken from something that fought like it had three of everything and a grudge about all of them. It still beats faintly when a bowstring is drawn nearby.
item.virginia_heart_pendant.name: Mutant Heart Pendant
item.volatile_bracers.description: Cracked bracers with glass vials of unstable fluid strapped to the underside.
item.volatile_bracers.lore: The vials are not supposed to be shaken. Everyone shakes them anyway.
item.volatile_bracers.name: Volatile Bracers
item.volatile_helmet.description: A dented helmet fitted with a small cracked canister that ticks quietly.
item.volatile_helmet.lore: The ticking is probably nothing. It has been probably nothing for a long time.
item.volatile_helmet.name: Volatile Helmet
item.warlord_necklace.description: A thick chain of skulls, teeth and beaten bronze, heavy as a yoke.
item.warlord_necklace.lore: Worn by tribal leaders and removed only by killing them. The island has seen many leaders.
item.warlord_necklace.name: Warlord Necklace
item.warlord_necklace.unique: Raises your maximum Frenzy stacks by 4.
item.warplate.description: A thick chest plate of layered steel, scarred from fights that went on all night.
item.warplate.lore: Part of a set made for the resort's private security, who never expected to use it. They did.
item.warplate.name: Warplate
item.weak_armor_hardening_mixture.descri: A tin of gray paste that smells of old pennies and glue.
item.weak_armor_hardening_mixture.lore: Brush it on and the gear stiffens. Mostly. Use gloves. Preferably two sets.
item.weak_armor_hardening_mixture.name: Weak Armor Hardening Mixture
item.weak_armor_hardening_mixture.unique: Adds the Armor stat to a piece of equipment that doesn't have one.
item.weathered_dog_tags.description: Two dented dog tags with the name scratched out and a small note taped between them.
item.weathered_dog_tags.lore: The note reads, in block capitals, 'FOLLOW ORDERS.' It does not say whose.
item.weathered_dog_tags.name: Weathered Dog Tags
item.welders_gloves.description: Scorched leather gloves still smelling of solder and burnt rubber.
item.welders_gloves.lore: Found on a workbench in the bunker, next to a half-finished something that was clearly not an invention.
item.welders_gloves.name: Welder's Gloves
item.whale_shark_tooth.description: A rare, smooth tooth too small for the animal it came from.
item.whale_shark_tooth.lore: Gentle giants do not usually lose teeth. This one fell out in a fight no one remembers.
item.whale_shark_tooth.name: Whale Shark Tooth
item.whale_shark_tooth.unique: Socket it into an empty slot on a piece of gear to add stats to that item.
item.white_crow_s_feather.description: A single snow-white crow feather that never gets wet.
item.white_crow_s_feather.lore: Island lore says the white crow only appears before a death. It left this behind, which is either a gift or a notice.
item.white_crow_s_feather.name: White Crow's Feather
item.white_crow_s_feather.unique: Socket it into an empty slot on a piece of gear to add stats to that item.
item.wind_armor.description: Light chest armor of overlapping gray plates that flutter and shift like feathers.
item.wind_armor.lore: Salvaged from the glider crash site, where someone fell for a very long time. The armor remembers moving fast.
item.wind_armor.name: Wind armor
item.wind_armor.unique: Dodging an attack gives +20% movement speed, +35% damage and +2000 armor, and heals 5% of your maximum life.
item.withered_crown.description: A crown of dry thorny twigs, brittle and gray, with dark stains in the bark.
item.withered_crown.lore: The doomsday cult's idea of royalty. It still catches blood, and what it catches does not stay put.
item.withered_crown.name: Withered Crown
item.withered_crown.unique: One cast of Blood Infused Arrow affects 4 additional projectiles.
item.wonderful_feather.description: A shimmering feather that shifts between green and violet as you turn it.
item.wonderful_feather.lore: The wind seems to hold still around it. Whatever bird dropped it was not entirely a bird.
item.wonderful_feather.name: Wonderful Feather
item.wonderful_feather.unique: Socket it into an empty slot on a piece of gear to add stats to that item.
item.wormhole_stabilizators.description: Heavy brass-and-wire bracers humming with a faint, uneasy pitch.
item.wormhole_stabilizators.lore: Salvaged from the buried complex, where something was being held open that should have stayed shut. They were never powered down.
item.wormhole_stabilizators.name: Wormhole Stabilizators
item.worn_bracer.description: A scuffed leather bracer, buckles polished by constant use.
item.worn_bracer.lore: Nothing glamorous. It protects the arm you swing with, which is arguably the one that matters.
item.worn_bracer.name: Worn Bracer
item.worn_shorts.description: Faded cotton shorts with a frayed hem and one pocket left.
item.worn_shorts.lore: Summer clothing on a winter island. Whoever owned these either planned very badly or had the island plan for them.
item.worn_shorts.name: Worn Shorts
item.wraps.description: Layers of cloth bandage wound tight around the hand and knuckles.
item.wraps.lore: The simplest gear on the island, and the most honest. They do exactly what they look like.
item.wraps.name: Wraps
item.yorium_s_assault.description: Spiked steel gauntlets fused with leather straps that never loosen.
item.yorium_s_assault.lore: Yorium's last gift to the world was a long line of broken faces.
item.yorium_s_assault.name: Yorium's Assault
item.yorium_s_assault.unique: Set piece. Melee weapon range +30% and melee attacks cost half the stamina.
item.yorium_s_burden.description: Huge, jagged pauldrons forged to make the wearer look larger than they are.
item.yorium_s_burden.lore: Yorium carried every grudge on these shoulders. They weigh more than they look.
item.yorium_s_burden.name: Yorium's Burden
item.yorium_s_burden.unique: Set piece. Melee weapon range +30% and melee attacks cost half the stamina.
item.yorium_s_gaze.description: A grim steel helm with a single narrow eye slit and a spike on the crown.
item.yorium_s_gaze.lore: Yorium never blinked in a fight. Behind this helm, you can't either.
item.yorium_s_gaze.name: Yorium's Gaze
item.yorium_s_gaze.unique: Set piece. Melee weapon range +30% and melee attacks cost half the stamina.
item.yorium_s_resolve.description: Thick steel bracers with studs along the forearm.
item.yorium_s_resolve.lore: Strapped on so tight they cut the circulation. Resolve, apparently, is pain tolerance.
item.yorium_s_resolve.name: Yorium's Resolve
item.yorium_s_resolve.unique: Set piece. Melee weapon range +30% and melee attacks cost half the stamina.
item.yorium_s_ruthlessness.description: A blackened steel cuirass with sharp spikes along the ribs.
item.yorium_s_ruthlessness.lore: Built for a warrior who gave no quarter and asked for none. The first part held up better.
item.yorium_s_ruthlessness.name: Yorium's Ruthlessness
item.yorium_s_ruthlessness.unique: Set piece. Melee weapon range +30% and melee attacks cost half the stamina.
item.yuki_onna_greaves.description: White silk leggings, stiff with frost and cold to the touch.
item.yuki_onna_greaves.lore: Never wet, never warm. The tribes tell their children not to look at them after dark.
item.yuki_onna_greaves.name: Yuki-Onna Greaves
item.yuki_onna_kimono.description: A long white kimono embroidered with drifting snowflakes.
item.yuki_onna_kimono.lore: Found folded on a rock at the top of a blizzard. The rock was empty. The kimono was not.
item.yuki_onna_kimono.name: Yuki-Onna Kimono
item.yuki_onna_s_headdress.description: A crown of ice-white combs and pale thread, always cold to the touch.
item.yuki_onna_s_headdress.lore: Wear it and the wind starts speaking to you in a woman's voice. It never says anything friendly.
item.yuki_onna_s_headdress.name: Yuki-Onna's Headdress
item.yuki_onna_strides.description: Pale, soft-soled boots that leave no tracks in snow.
item.yuki_onna_strides.lore: The snow woman walks and the ground forgets her. Follow the missing footprints at your own risk.
item.yuki_onna_strides.name: Yuki-Onna Strides
item.zipline_grippers.description: Rubber-grip boots with a clip for ziplines and a hook for anything unlucky.
item.zipline_grippers.lore: Tried and tested on the long line over the bay. The test subject did not come back for a refund.
item.zipline_grippers.name: Zipline Grippers
item.zipline_grippers.unique: +1 jump power and you can bunny hop.
perk.adrenaline_rush.effect: Grants a short surge of speed and drive.
perk.adrenaline_rush.name: Adrenaline Rush
perk.adrenaline_rush_ii.effect: Strengthens the surge from Adrenaline Rush.
perk.adrenaline_rush_ii.name: Adrenaline Rush II
perk.afterburn.effect: Black flames have a chance to weaken enemies so they take more damage for a few seconds.
perk.afterburn.name: Afterburn
perk.all_attributes.name: All attributes
perk.all_attributes_2.flavor: Survival is a hell of a trainer.
perk.all_attributes_2.name: Hardened Survivor
perk.all_attributes_3.effect: +10 Strength, Vitality, Agility and Intelligence per stack.
perk.all_attributes_3.flavor: The island made you what you are.
perk.all_attributes_3.name: Island Forged
perk.alternative_cloth_sources.effect: Gain 10 more cloth each day, and craft furs into cloth by placing duplicates on a crafting mat.
perk.alternative_cloth_sources.flavor: Rags are rags. Stitch the pelts.
perk.alternative_cloth_sources.name: Furs to Fabric
perk.anti_armor_projectiles.name: Anti armor projectiles
perk.anti_magic_training.effect: Magic damage taken is reduced by 20%.
perk.anti_magic_training.flavor: Weird things hurt less when you expect them.
perk.anti_magic_training.name: Anti-Magic Training
perk.arcane_blood.effect: Blood infused arrow deals 5 more damage per health spent, per stack.
perk.arcane_blood.name: Arcane Blood
perk.arm_strength.name: Arm Strength
perk.armageddon.flavor: Cast, and let the sky fall.
perk.armageddon.name: Armageddon
perk.armor.name: Armor
perk.armor_penetration.effect: +5 armor penetration on all attacks per stack.
perk.armor_penetration.name: Armor Penetration
perk.armor_piercing_edge.name: Armor Piercing Edge
perk.attack_speed.name: Attack speed
perk.autocast_shield.effect: With Energy Shield equipped, it casts itself while energy and stamina are above 90% of max.
perk.autocast_shield.name: Autocast Shield
perk.bleed.effect: Hits have a +7% chance to make the target bleed, per stack.
perk.bleed.flavor: Leave a trail they can follow home.
perk.bleed.name: Bleed
perk.blink_passthrough.effect: Blink damages enemies you teleport through.
perk.blink_passthrough.flavor: Step through them and leave a mark.
perk.blink_passthrough.name: Blink: Rift Slash
perk.blink_wormhole.effect: Blink travels 10 feet farther, per stack.
perk.blink_wormhole.name: Blink - Wormhole
perk.block.effect: +20 block. Block reduces the damage you take after armor and other reductions.
perk.block.flavor: Take the edge off every hit.
perk.block.name: Block
perk.body_strength.flavor: Built like something the cannibals avoid.
perk.body_strength.name: Body Strength
perk.body_strength_ii.name: Body Strength II
perk.bonus_health.name: Bonus Health
perk.booze.effect: Gain 5 more booze each day, per stack. Excess beyond your carry limit is lost.
perk.booze.name: Booze
perk.bow_specialization.name: Bow Specialization
perk.breath_under_control.effect: +0.5 stamina recovered per second per stack.
perk.breath_under_control.flavor: In through the nose, out through the chase.
perk.breath_under_control.name: Breath under control
perk.breathing_tehniques.effect: While Black Flame is active, attack speed is fixed at 200%.
perk.breathing_tehniques.name: Breathing Tehniques
perk.bullseye.flavor: Dead center, every time it counts.
perk.bullseye.name: Bullseye
perk.bunny_hopping.effect: Improves the landing speed burst from Momentum transfer: it is faster and lasts longer.
perk.bunny_hopping.name: Bunny hopping
perk.charge_pushback.effect: Charged melee attacks knock enemies back.
perk.charge_pushback.flavor: Wind up and shove them out.
perk.charge_pushback.name: Charge Pushback
perk.charged_attack.effect: Charged melee attacks deal 60% more damage.
perk.charged_attack.name: Charged Attack
perk.closing_wounds.effect: Purge also heals all players for a share of their missing health and restores a share of their missing energy.
perk.closing_wounds.name: Closing Wounds
perk.combat_energy_regen.name: Combat Energy Regen
perk.combat_health_regen.name: Combat Health Regen
perk.combat_regen.effect: Restore 3 stamina on hit, per stack.
perk.combat_regen.flavor: Violence is a decent second wind.
perk.combat_regen.name: Combat Regen
perk.concussive_bash.effect: Bash's active and passive effects last 4 seconds longer per stack. If bash causes bleed, bleed deals more total damage.
perk.concussive_bash.name: Concussive Bash
perk.concussive_shot.effect: Enemies hit by a critical Blood Infused Arrow are stunned for 5 seconds.
perk.concussive_shot.flavor: Ring their bell from across the clearing.
perk.concussive_shot.name: Concussive shot
perk.cooldown_reduction.effect: Spell cooldowns are 8% shorter per stack.
perk.cooldown_reduction.name: Cooldown Reduction
perk.corpse_collecting.effect: +100 bone and +20 skull carry capacity per stack.
perk.corpse_collecting.name: Corpse collecting
perk.corrosive_skin.effect: Getting hit reduces the attacker's armor by 250% of your armor penetration.
perk.corrosive_skin.flavor: Touch me and your gear rots.
perk.corrosive_skin.name: Corrosive Skin
perk.counter_strike.effect: Parrying stores bonus melee damage for 20 seconds, equal to 150% of the parry's damage. Spent on your next melee attack.
perk.counter_strike.flavor: Let them hit you. Then return the favor.
perk.counter_strike.name: Counter Strike
perk.craftable_plane_axe.effect: Unlocks crafting of the Rescue Axe: 1 crafted axe, 1 rope and 2 sticks.
perk.craftable_plane_axe.flavor: Emergency gear, now with a handle you can trust.
perk.craftable_plane_axe.name: Rescue Axe
perk.critical_infusion.effect: Blood Infused Arrow always scores a critical hit.
perk.critical_infusion.flavor: Every drop of blood finds the mark.
perk.critical_infusion.name: Critical Infusion
perk.crossbow_specialization.name: Crossbow Specialization
perk.curse_of_binding.effect: Ranged weapons deal no damage, but melee damage is increased by 350%.
perk.curse_of_binding.flavor: Your guns go cold. Your fists don't.
perk.curse_of_binding.name: Curse of Binding
perk.curse_of_binding_2.effect: Melee attacks deal 99% less damage, but ranged damage is doubled.
perk.curse_of_binding_2.flavor: The blade stays sheathed. The barrel does the talking.
perk.curse_of_binding_2.name: Curse of the Dead Fist
perk.curse_of_crippling.effect: +200% ranged damage, but -25% movement speed and -35% jump power.
perk.curse_of_crippling.flavor: Stand still and make it count.
perk.curse_of_crippling.name: Curse of Crippling
perk.curse_of_power.effect: +400% spell damage, but bonus base melee and ranged damage are halved.
perk.curse_of_power.flavor: Spells for blood, blades for nothing.
perk.curse_of_power.name: Curse of Power
perk.curse_of_quickening.effect: +45% attack speed, but melee damage is reduced by 10% and ranged damage by 20%.
perk.curse_of_quickening.name: Curse of Quickening
perk.curse_of_quickening_2.effect: +50% ranged damage, projectile size, projectile speed and crit damage; -20% attack speed; spell costs are tripled.
perk.curse_of_quickening_2.flavor: Power now. The bill comes in mana.
perk.curse_of_quickening_2.name: Curse of Overcharge
perk.curse_of_size.effect: Spell damage is doubled, but maximum energy is cut by 35% and stamina regenerates 35% slower.
perk.curse_of_size.name: Curse of Size
perk.curse_of_speed.effect: Cooldowns are halved, but attack speed is reduced by 40%.
perk.curse_of_speed.name: Curse of Speed
perk.curse_of_strengthening.effect: -30% attack speed, but melee damage is doubled.
perk.curse_of_strengthening.name: Curse of Strengthening
perk.curse_of_thorns.effect: Thorns damage is tripled, thorns armor piercing +300%, damage taken -5%; bonus flat melee and ranged damage are cut by 20%.
perk.curse_of_thorns.flavor: Hurt me and see what happens.
perk.curse_of_thorns.name: Curse of Thorns
perk.cursed_arrow.effect: Blood Infused Arrow deals triple damage, but all recovery is reduced by 25% and you lose energy briefly after casting it.
perk.cursed_arrow.flavor: Triple damage, paid for in blood.
perk.cursed_arrow.name: Cursed Arrow
perk.dance_of_the_firegod.effect: While Black Flame is active, melee damage and spell cost both scale with your speed. Black Flame also disables Berserk's unlimited stamina.
perk.dance_of_the_firegod.flavor: Burn bright, move faster, pay more.
perk.dance_of_the_firegod.name: Dance of the Firegod
perk.deadeye.effect: +20% pistol headshot chance, for a total of 30%. Headshots trigger at random on hit.
perk.deadeye.flavor: One eye shut, one bullet true.
perk.deadeye.name: Deadeye
perk.demolition.effect: Gain 2 more bombs each day, per stack. Excess beyond your carry limit is lost.
perk.demolition.flavor: A tidy stockpile of loud solutions.
perk.demolition.name: Demolition
perk.demolition_expert.effect: Gain 5 more dynamite each day, per stack. Excess beyond your carry limit is lost.
perk.demolition_expert.name: Demolition Expert
perk.dense_matter.effect: Black holes cannot pull you in.
perk.dense_matter.name: Dense Matter
perk.deployable_shield.effect: Dodging grants a shield equal to 15% of your max health.
perk.deployable_shield.name: Deployable Shield
perk.deployable_shield_2.effect: Further strengthens the shield you gain from dodging.
perk.deployable_shield_2.flavor: The shield learned a few new tricks.
perk.deployable_shield_2.name: Bulwark Reflex
perk.disabler.effect: Magic arrow's negative effects last 5 seconds longer.
perk.disabler.name: Disabler
perk.dodge.effect: Enemies are 10% less likely to hit you.
perk.dodge.flavor: Blades find only the air you left.
perk.dodge.name: Dodge
perk.double_spears.effect: Thrown spears that hit have a 40% chance to spawn a second spear that flies at the same target.
perk.double_spears.flavor: One for the throat, one for the ribs.
perk.double_spears.name: Double spears

spell.ball_lightning.description: Releases a crackling orb that deals 1,220 base damage plus 75x spell damage, and can crit with the right gear. 350 energy, 100 s cooldown.
spell.ball_lightning.name: Ball Lightning
spell.bash.description: A shield-first slam that slows enemies by 40% for 2 s and makes them take 30% more damage. Gear adds bleed and lifesteal. 25 energy, 25 s cooldown.
spell.bash.name: Bash
spell.berserk.description: Fly into a 30 s rage: +30% damage, +35% movement speed and +25% attack speed, at the cost of your max health. 10 energy, 200 s cooldown.
spell.berserk.name: Berserk
spell.black_flame.description: Toggle a cold black fire that damages nearby enemies steadily, scaling with spell damage (x0.4). Keep it lit as long as your energy lasts. 25 energy, 2.5 s cooldown.
spell.black_flame.name: Black Flame
spell.black_hole.description: Tears open a 15 m gravity well for 9 s that drags enemies to its core and crushes them with heavy magic damage scaling with spell damage. 350 energy, 140 s cooldown.
spell.black_hole.name: Black Hole
spell.blink.description: Teleport up to 15 m in the direction you face. Great for dodging, awful for dignity. Gear can extend range or make arrival explosive. 25 energy, 14 s cooldown.
spell.blink.name: Blink
spell.blood_infused_arrow.description: Pay with your own health to loose an arrow whose damage grows with the life you sacrifice, plus a spell damage bonus. Painful, effective. 75 energy, 8 s cooldown.
spell.blood_infused_arrow.name: Blood Infused Arrow
spell.cataclysm.description: Calls down a 12 s vortex of 5 m radius that grinds everything inside for 40 damage plus 25x spell damage. The island's loudest apology. 500 energy, 300 s cooldown.
spell.cataclysm.name: Cataclysm
spell.firebolt.description: Lobs a quick fire bolt for 1.2x spell damage, igniting what it hits. The first spell every survivor learns, and the one they never stop using. 45 energy, 20 s cooldown.
spell.firebolt.name: Firebolt
spell.focus.description: Steady your breath: headshots hit +50% harder and body shots +15%, slowing aimed targets by 80% for 4 s. 40 energy, 20 s cooldown.
spell.focus.name: Focus
spell.frenzy.description: Free to cast. Each hit stacks +2% attack speed and +7.5% damage, up to 5 stacks, until you stop swinging. 0 energy, 40 s cooldown.
spell.frenzy.name: Frenzy
spell.golden_skin.description: Plates your body in living gold for a stretch of near-invulnerable armor. Slow, shiny, hard to kill. 65 energy, 160 s cooldown.
spell.golden_skin.name: Golden Skin
spell.healing_dome.description: Raises a glowing dome for 10 s that mends everyone standing inside it. A moving field hospital, if the patients stay put. 80 energy, 70 s cooldown.
spell.healing_dome.name: Healing Dome
spell.magic_arrow.description: Looses one huge arcane bolt dealing 4.2x spell damage, with a 10 s lingering effect. Perks can turn it into a volley. 100 energy, 20 s cooldown.
spell.magic_arrow.name: Magic Arrow
spell.multishot.description: Toggle: every shot fans into extra projectiles at a 25% damage penalty each. Drains 30 energy per use, and gear can add more arrows. 12 s cooldown.
spell.multishot.name: Multishot
spell.parry.description: Counter an incoming blow within 3.5 m for 40 damage plus 3x spell damage, then gain +1 attack speed for 10 s. 35 energy, 60 s cooldown.
spell.parry.name: Parry
spell.portal.description: Tears a doorway through the island that stays open for 30 s, letting you and your companions cross it freely. 90 energy, 60 s cooldown.
spell.portal.name: Portal
spell.purge.description: Cleanses debuffs from everything within 30 m. Perks make it heal you or amplify your damage for a time. 40 energy, 16 s cooldown.
spell.purge.name: Purge
spell.roaring_cheeks.description: A thunderous blast of foul wind: 30 m radius, hard knockback, 80% slow for 30 s and 50 base damage plus 5x spell damage. Nobody wins. 400 energy, 360 s cooldown.
spell.roaring_cheeks.name: Roaring Cheeks
spell.seeking_arrow.description: Fires a homing arrow that finds its mark for 10 s, deals +50% on headshots and slows its victim by 90% for 4 s. 50 energy, 5 s cooldown.
spell.seeking_arrow.name: Seeking Arrow
spell.snap_freeze.description: Flash-freezes enemies within 12 m for 7 s and deals 6.5x spell damage as they shatter against the cold. 220 energy, 40 s cooldown.
spell.snap_freeze.name: Snap Freeze
spell.snow_storm.description: Summons a whirling blizzard that chews through enemies in its area, scaling x0.4 with spell damage per charge, up to 10 charges. 120 energy, 20 s cooldown.
spell.snow_storm.name: Snow Storm
spell.sun_flare.description: Hurls a false sun that burns for 20 s over an 8.5 m area: enemies inside are slowed by 40% and scorched, while allies are mended. 100 energy, 70 s cooldown.
spell.sun_flare.name: Sun Flare
spell.sustain_shield.description: Channel to build a barrier at 3 points per second, up to a cap of 15, which lingers 20 s after you stop. Drains 50 energy for every second held.
spell.sustain_shield.name: Sustain Shield
spell.taunt.description: Insults everything in earshot so it charges you instead of your friends. Great way to hold a line, or lose one. 40 energy, 45 s cooldown.
spell.taunt.name: Taunt
spell.war_cry.description: A bellow across 50 m that rallies you and nearby allies: 20% more attack speed and 20% more damage for the duration. 85 energy, 180 s cooldown.
spell.war_cry.name: War Cry
spell.wide_reach.description: A cheap reflex cast that extends your reach past arm's length. Fast enough to spam: 10 energy, 0.4 s cooldown.
spell.wide_reach.name: Wide Reach
